verses.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.am: የከበርህ ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያው በዓይን ያዩትና የቃሉ አገልጋዮች የሆኑት እንዳስተላለፉልን፥

verses.en: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሄሮድስ ዘመን ከአብያ ክፍል የሆነ ዘካርያስ የሚባል አንድ ካህን ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም ከአሮን ልጆች ነበረች፥ ስምዋም ኤልሳቤጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they were both righteous before YAHUAH, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Master blameless.
verses.am: ሁለቱም በጌታ ትእዛዝና ሕግጋት ሁሉ ያለ ነቀፋ እየሄዱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቃን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
verses.am: ኤልሳቤጥም መካን ነበረችና ልጅ አልነበራቸውም፤ ሁለቱም በዕድሜያቸው አርጅተው ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before YAHUAH in the order of his course,
verses.am: እርሱም በክፍሉ ተራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሲያገለግል፥

verses.en: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Master.
verses.am: እንደ ካህናት ሥርዓት ወደ ጌታ ቤተ መቅደስ ገብቶ ለማጠን ዕጣ ደረሰበት።

verses.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.am: በዕጣንም ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በውጭ ቆመው ይጸልዩ ነበር።

verses.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Master standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.am: የጌታም መልአክ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ ቀኝ ቆሞ ታየው።

verses.en: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.am: ዘካርያስም ባየው ጊዜ ደነገጠ፥ ፍርሃትም ወደቀበት።

verses.en: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name Yohanan.
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አለው። ዘካርያስ ሆይ፥ ጸሎትህ ተሰምቶልሃልና አትፍራ ሚስትህ ኤልሳቤጥም ወንድ ልጅ ትወልድልሃለች፥ ስሙንም ዮሐንስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.am: ደስታና ተድላም ይሆንልሃል፥ በመወለዱም ብዙዎች ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Master, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Set-apart Spirit, even from his mother's womb.
verses.am: በጌታ ፊት ታላቅ ይሆናልና፥ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክር መጠጥ አይጠጣም፤ ገናም በእናቱ ማኅፀን ሳለ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላበታል፤

verses.en: And many of the children of Yisra'el shall he turn to the Master their YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ብዙዎችን ወደ ጌታ ወደ አምላካቸው ይመልሳል።

verses.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Master.
verses.am: እርሱም የተዘጋጁትን ሕዝብ ለጌታ እንዲያሰናዳ፥ የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆች የማይታዘዙትንም ወደ ጻድቃን ጥበብ ይመልስ ዘንድ በኤልያስ መንፈስና ኃይል በፊቱ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.am: ዘካርያስም መልአኩን። እኔ ሽማግሌ ነኝ ምስቴም በዕድሜዋ አርጅታለችና ይህን በምን አውቃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of YAHUAH; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ። እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የምቆመው ገብርኤል ነኝ፥ እንድናገርህም ይህችንም የምሥራች እንድሰብክልህ ተልኬ ነበር፤

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በጊዜው የሚፈጸመውን ቃሌን ስላላመንህ፥ ይህ ነገር እስከሚሆን ቀን ድረስ ዲዳ ትሆናለህ መናገርም አትችልም አለው።

verses.en: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ዘካርያስን ይጠብቁት ነበር፤ በቤተ መቅደስም ውስጥ ስለ ዘገየ ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.am: በወጣም ጊዜ ሊነግራቸው አልቻለም፥ በቤተ መቅደስም ራእይ እንዳየ አስተዋሉ፤ እርሱም ይጠቅሳቸው ነበር፤ ድዳም ሆኖ ኖረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.am: የማገልገሉም ወራት ሲፈጸም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.am: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥

verses.en: Thus hath the Master dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.am: በስድስተኛውም ወር መልአኩ ገብርኤል ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ወደ ገሊላ ከተማ፥

verses.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from YAHUAH unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.am: ከዳዊት ወገን ለሆነው ዮሴፍ ለሚባል ሰው ወደ ታጨች ወደ አንዲት ድንግል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተላከ፥ የድንግሊቱም ስም ማርያም ነበረ።

verses.en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Yoseph, of the house of Dawid; and the virgin's name was Miryam.
verses.am: መልአኩም ወደ እርስዋ ገብቶ። ደስ ይበልሽ፥ ጸጋ የሞላብሽ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ከአንቺ ጋር ነው፤ አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ አላት።

verses.en: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Master is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
verses.am: እርስዋም ባየችው ጊዜ ከንግግሩ በጣም ደነገጠችና። ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰላምታ ነው? ብላ አሰበች።

verses.en: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላት። ማርያም ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጸጋ አግኝተሻልና አትፍሪ።

verses.en: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Miryam: for thou hast found favour with YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ትፀንሻለሽ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ፥ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ ትዪዋለሽ።

verses.en: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name Yahushua.
verses.am: እርሱ ታላቅ ይሆናል የልዑል ልጅም ይባላል፥ ጌታ አምላክም የአባቱን የዳዊትን ዙፋን ይሰጠዋል፤

verses.en: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and YAHUAH shall give unto him the throne of his father Dawid:
verses.am: በያዕቆብ ቤትም ላይ ለዘለላም ይነግሣል፥ ለመንግሥቱም መጨረሻ የለውም።

verses.en: And he shall reign over the house of Ya'aqob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.am: ማርያምም መልአኩን። ወንድ ስለማላውቅ ይህ እንዴት ይሆናል? አለችው።

verses.en: Then said Miryam unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ እንዲህ አላት። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በአንቺ ላይ ይመጣል፥ የልዑልም ኃይል ይጸልልሻል ስለዚህ ደግሞ ከአንቺ የሚወለደው ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ይባላል።

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Set-apart Spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆም ዘመድሽ ኤልሳቤጥ፥ እርስዋ ደግሞ በእርጅናዋ ወንድ ልጅ ፀንሳለች፥ ለእርስዋም መካን ትባል ለነበረችው ይህ ስድስተኛ ወር ነው፤

verses.en: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር የለምና።

verses.en: For with YAHUAH nothing shall be impossible.
verses.am: ማርያምም። እነሆኝ የጌታ ባሪያ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁንልኝ አለች። መልአኩም ከእርስዋ ሄደ።

verses.en: And Miryam said, Behold the handmaid of the Master; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.am: ማርያምም በዚያ ወራት ተነሥታ ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወደ ይሁዳ ከተማ ፈጥና ወጣች፥

verses.en: And Miryam arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.am: ወደ ዘካርያስም ቤት ገብታ ኤልሳቤጥን ተሳለመቻት።

verses.en: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.am: ኤልሳቤጥም የማርያምን ሰላምታ በሰማች ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀንዋ ውስጥ ዘለለ፤ በኤልሳቤጥም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባት፥

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Miryam, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Set-apart Spirit:
verses.am: በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኻ እንዲህ አለች። አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ፥ የማኅፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።

verses.en: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.am: የጌታዬ እናት ወደ እኔ ትመጣ ዘንድ እንዴት ይሆንልኛል?

verses.en: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Master should come to me?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሰላምታሽ ድምጽ በጆሮዬ በመጣ ጊዜ ፅንሱ በማኅፀኔ በደስታ ዘሎአልና።

verses.en: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.am: ከጌታ፤ የተነገረላት ቃል ይፈጸማልና ያመነች ብፅዕት ናት።

verses.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Master.
verses.am: ማርያምም እንዲህ አለች።

verses.en: And Miryam said, My soul doth magnify the Master,
verses.am: ነፍሴ ጌታን ታከብረዋለች፥ መንፈሴም በአምላኬ በመድኃኒቴ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤

verses.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in YAHUAH my Saviour.
verses.am: የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል፤

verses.en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.am: ብርቱ የሆነ እርሱ በእኔ ታላቅ ሥራ አድርጎአልና፤ ስሙም ቅዱስ ነው።

verses.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
verses.am: ምሕረቱም ለሚፈሩት እስከ ትውልድና ትውልድ ይኖራል።

verses.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.am: በክንዱ ኃይል አድርጎአል፤ ትዕቢተኞችን በልባቸው አሳብ በትኖአል፤

verses.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.am: ገዥዎችን ከዙፋናቸው አዋርዶአል፤ ትሑታንንም ከፍ አድርጎአል፤

verses.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.am: የተራቡትን በበጎ ነገር አጥግቦአል፤ ባለ ጠጎችንም ባዶአቸውን ሰዶአቸዋል።

verses.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.am: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.en: He hath holpen his servant Yisra'el, in remembrance of his mercy;
verses.am: ማርያምም ሦስት ወር የሚያህል በእርስዋ ዘንድ ተቀመጠች ወደ ቤትዋም ተመለሰች።

verses.en: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.am: የኤልሳቤጥም የመውለጃዋ ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።

verses.en: And Miryam abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.am: ጎረቤቶችዋም ዘመዶችዋም ጌታ ምሕረቱን እንዳገነነላት ሰምተው ከእርስዋ ጋር ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕፃኑን ሊገርዙት መጡ፥ በአባቱም ስም ዘካርያስ ሊሉት ወደዱ።

verses.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Master had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.am: እናቱ ግን መልሳ። አይሆንም፥ ዮሐንስ ይባል እንጂ አለች።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ከወገንሽ ማንም በዚህ ስም የተጠራ የለም አሉአት።

verses.en: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called Yohanan.
verses.am: አባቱንም ማን ሊባል እንዲወድ ጠቀሱት።

verses.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.am: ብራናም ለምኖ። ስሙ ዮሐንስ ነው ብሎ ጻፈ። ሁሉም አደነቁ።

verses.en: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.am: ያንጊዜም አፉ ተከፈተ መላሱም ተፈታ እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is Yohanan. And they marvelled all.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ፍርሃት ሆነ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ነገር በይሁዳ በተራራማው አገር ሁሉ ተወራ፤

verses.en: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሁሉ። እንኪያ ይህ ሕፃን ምን ይሆን? እያሉ በልባቸው አኖሩት፤ የጌታ እጅ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረችና።

verses.en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.am: አባቱ ዘካርያስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላበትና ትንቢት ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Master was with him.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ጌታ አምላክ ይባረክ፥ ጐብኝቶ ለሕዝቡ ቤዛ አድርጎአልና፤

verses.en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Set-apart Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
verses.am: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.am: ማዳኑም ከወደረኞቻችንና ከሚጠሉን ሁሉ እጅ ነው፤

verses.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant Dawid;
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.am: ደግሞም አንተ ሕፃን ሆይ፥ የልዑል ነቢይ ትባላለህ፥ መንገዱን ልትጠርግ በጌታ ፊት ትሄዳለህና፤

verses.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.am: እንደዚህም የኃጢአታቸው ስርየት የሆነውን የመዳን እውቀት ለሕዝቡ ትሰጣለህ፤

verses.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.am: ይህም ከላይ የመጣ ብርሃን በጐበኘበት በአምላካችን ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ምክንያት ነው፤

verses.en: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.am: ብርሃኑም በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ተቀምጠው ላሉት ያበራል እግሮቻችንንም በሰላም መንገድ ያቀናል።

verses.en: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ በመንፈስም ጠነከረ፥ ለእስራኤልም እስከ ታየበት ቀን ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ኖረ።

verses.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Master to prepare his ways;
To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
Through the tender mercy of our YAHUAH; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Yisra'el.
And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት ዓለሙ ሁሉ እንዲጻፍ ከአውግስጦስ ቄሣር ትእዛዝ ወጣች።

verses.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.am: ቄሬኔዎስ በሶርያ አገር ገዥ በነበረ ጊዜ ይህ የመጀመሪያ ጽሕፈት ሆነ።

verses.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.am: ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወደ ከተማው ሄደ።

verses.en: And Yoseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of Dawid, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of Dawid:)
To be taxed with Miryam his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ደግሞ ከዳዊት ቤትና ወገን ስለ ነበረ ከገሊላ ከናዝሬት ከተማ ተነሥቶ ቤተ ልሔም ወደምትባል ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ይሁዳ፥ ፀንሳ ከነበረች ከእጮኛው ከማርያም ጋር ይጻፍ ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.am: በዚያም ሳሉ የመውለጃዋ ወራት ደረሰ፥

verses.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.am: የበኵር ልጅዋንም ወለደች፥ በመጠቅለያም ጠቀለለችው፤ በእንግዶችም ማደሪያ ስፍራ ስላልነበራቸው በግርግም አስተኛችው።

verses.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.am: በዚያም ምድር መንጋቸውን በሌሊት ሲጠብቁ በሜዳ ያደሩ እረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And, lo, the angel of the Master came upon them, and the glory of the Master shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ እነርሱ ቀረበ የጌታ ክብርም በዙሪያቸው አበራ፥ ታላቅ ፍርሃትም ፈሩ።

verses.en: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.am: መልአኩም እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ የሚሆን ታላቅ ደስታ የምሥራች እነግራችኋለሁና አትፍሩ፤

verses.en: For unto you is born this day in the city of Dawid a Saviour, which is Messiah the Master.
verses.am: ዛሬ በዳዊት ከተማ መድኃኒት እርሱም ክርስቶስ ጌታ የሆነ ተወልዶላችኋልና።

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.am: ይህም ምልክት ይሆንላችኋል፤ ሕፃን ተጠቅልሎ በግርግምም ተኝቶ ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising YAHUAH, and saying,
verses.am: ድንገትም ብዙ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ከመልአኩ ጋር ነበሩ። እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑ።

verses.en: Glory to YAHUAH in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.am: ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር በአርያም ይሁን ሰላምም በምድር ለሰውም በጎ ፈቃድ አሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Master hath made known unto us.
verses.am: መላእክትም ከእነርሱ ተለይተው ወደ ሰማይ በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እረኞቹ እርስ በርሳቸው። እንግዲህ እስከ ቤተ ልሔም ድረስ እንሂድ እግዚአብሔርም የገለጠልንን ይህን የሆነውን ነገር እንይ ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they came with haste, and found Miryam, and Yoseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.am: ፈጥነውም መጡ ማርያምንና ዮሴፍን ሕፃኑንም በግርግም ተኝቶ አገኙ።

verses.en: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.am: አይተውም ስለዚህ ሕፃን የተነገረላቸውን ነገር ገለጡ።

verses.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.am: የሰሙትን ሁሉ እረኞቹ በነገሩአቸው ነገር አደነቁ፤

verses.en: But Miryam kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.am: ማርያም ግን ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ እያሰበች ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising YAHUAH for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.am: እረኞችም እንደ ተባለላቸው ስለ ሰሙትና ስላዩት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called Yahushua, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.am: ሊገርዙት ስምንት ቀን በሞላ ጊዜ፥ በማኅፀን ሳይረገዝ በመልአኩ እንደ ተባለ፥ ስሙ ኢየሱስ ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Mosheh were accomplished, they brought him to Yerushalayim, to present him to the Master;
(As it is written in the law of the Master, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Master;)
verses.am: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ የመንጻታቸው ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጌታ ሕግ። የእናቱን ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ወንድ ሁሉ ለጌታ የተቀደሰ ይባላል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በጌታ ፊት ሊያቆሙት፥ በጌታም ሕግ። ሁለት ዋሊያ ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ጫጩቶች እንደ ተባለ፥ መሥዋዕት ሊያቀርቡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Master, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.am: እንደ ሙሴም ሕግ የመንጻታቸው ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጌታ ሕግ። የእናቱን ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ወንድ ሁሉ ለጌታ የተቀደሰ ይባላል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በጌታ ፊት ሊያቆሙት፥ በጌታም ሕግ። ሁለት ዋሊያ ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ጫጩቶች እንደ ተባለ፥ መሥዋዕት ሊያቀርቡ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man in Yerushalayim, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Yisra'el: and the Set-apart Spirit was upon him.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ስምዖን የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፥ ይህም ሰው የእስራኤልን መጽናናት ይጠባበቅ ነበር፤ ጻድቅና ትጉህም ነበረ፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it was revealed unto him by the Set-apart Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Master's Messiah.
verses.am: በጌታም የተቀባውን ሳያይ ሞትን እንዳያይ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተረድቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Yahushua, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.am: በመንፈስም ወደ መቅደስ ወጣ፤ ወላጆቹም እንደ ሕጉ ልማድ ያደርጉለት ዘንድ ሕፃኑን ኢየሱስን በአስገቡት ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed YAHUAH, and said,
verses.am: እርሱ ደግሞ ተቀብሎ አቀፈው እግዚአብሔርንም እየባረከ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: Master, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሁን እንደ ቃልህ ባሪያህን በሰላም ታሰናብተዋለህ፤

verses.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.am: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።

verses.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.am: ይህም ለአሕዛብ ሁሉን የሚገልጥ ብርሃን ለሕዝብህም ለእስራኤል ክብር ነው።

verses.en: A light to lighten the nations, and the glory of thy people Yisra'el.
verses.am: ዮሴፍና እናቱም ስለ እርሱ በተባለው ነገር ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And Yoseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.am: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤

verses.en: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Miryam his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Yisra'el; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.am: ከአሴር ወገንም የምትሆን የፋኑኤል ልጅ ሐና የምትባል አንዲት ነቢይት ነበረች፤ እርስዋም ከድንግልናዋ ጀምራ ከባልዋ ጋር ሰባት ዓመት ኖረች፤

verses.en: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.am: እርስዋም ሰማኒያ አራት ዓመት ያህል መበለት ሆና በጣም አርጅታ ነበር፤ በጾምና በጸሎትም ሌሊትና ቀን እያገለገለች ከመቅደስ አትለይም ነበር።

verses.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.am: በዚያችም ሰዓት ቀርባ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነች፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤዛ ለሚጠባበቁ ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ትናገር ነበር።

verses.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served YAHUAH with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.am: ሁሉንም እንደ ጌታ ሕግ ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ወደ ገሊላ ወደ ከተማቸው ወደ ናዝሬት ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Master, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ሕፃኑም አደገ፥ ጥበብም ሞልቶበት በመንፈስ ጠነከረ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ጸጋ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Master, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.am: ወላጆቹም በያመቱ በፋሲካ በዓል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of YAHUAH was upon him.
verses.am: የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እንደ በዓሉ ሥርዓት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ፤

verses.en: Now his parents went to Yerushalayim every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.am: ቀኖቹንም ከፈጸሙ በኋላ፥ ሲመለሱ ብላቴናው ኢየሱስ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀርቶ ነበር፥ ዮሴፍም እናቱም አላወቁም ነበር።

verses.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Yerushalayim after the custom of the feast.
verses.am: ከመንገደኞች ጋር የነበረ ስለ መሰላቸው የአንድ ቀን መንገድ ሄዱ፥ ከዘመዶቻቸውም ከሚያውቋቸውም ዘንድ ፈለጉት፤

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Yahushua tarried behind in Yerushalayim; and Yoseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.am: ባጡትም ጊዜ እየፈለጉት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

verses.en: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.am: ከሦስት ቀንም በኋላ በመምህራን መካከል ተቀምጦ ሲሰማቸውም ሲጠይቃቸውም በመቅደስ አገኙት፤

verses.en: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Yerushalayim, seeking him.
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሁሉ በማስተዋሉና በመልሱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.am: ባዩትም ጊዜ ተገረሙ፥ እናቱም። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ለምን እንዲህ አደረግህብን? እነሆ፥ አባትህና እኔ እየተጨነቅን ስንፈልግህ ነበርን አለችው።

verses.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ፈለጋችሁኝ? በአባቴ ቤት እሆን ዘንድ እንዲገባኝ አላወቃችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.am: እነርሱም የተናገራቸውን ነገር አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፥ ይታዘዝላቸውም ነበር። እናቱም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ በልብዋ ትጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በጥበብና በቁመት በሞገስም በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው ፊት ያድግ ነበር።

verses.en: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
And Yahushua increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with YAHUAH and man.

Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.am: ጢባርዮስ ቄሣርም በነገሠ በአሥራ አምስተኛይቱ ዓመት፥ ጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስም በይሁዳ ሲገዛ፥ ሄሮድስም በገሊላ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ወንድሙ ፊልጶስም በኢጡርያስ በጥራኮኒዶስም አገር የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ፥ ሊሳኒዮስም በሳቢላኒስ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሆነው ሳሉ፥

verses.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of YAHUAH came unto Yohanan the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.am: ሐናና ቀያፋም ሊቃነ ካህናት ሳሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ ልጅ ወደ ዮሐንስ በምድረ በዳ መጣ።

verses.en: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the immersion of repentance for the remission of sins;
As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Master, make his paths straight.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ቃል መጽሐፍ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ፤ ዐዘቅቱ ሁሉ ይሙላ ተራራውና ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፥ ጠማማውም የቀና መንገድ ይሁን፥ ሸካራውም መንገድ ትክክል ይሁን፤ ሥጋም የለበሰ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን ይይ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ለኃጢአት ስርየት የንስሐን ጥምቀት እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ ዙሪያ ወዳለችው አገር ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be immersed of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ሊጠመቁ ለወጡት ሕዝብ እንዲህ ይላቸው ነበር። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That YAHUAH is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤ በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን ማለትን አትጀምሩ፤ ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር እንዲችል እላችኋለሁና።

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.am: አሁንስ ምሳር ደግሞ በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.en: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.am: መልሶም። ሁለት ልብስ ያለው ለሌለው ያካፍል፥ ምግብም ያለው እንዲሁ ያድርግ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: Then came also publicans to be immersed, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.am: ቀራጮችም ደግሞ ሊጠመቁ መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.am: ከታዘዘላችሁ አብልጣችሁ አትውሰዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ። እኛ ደግሞ ምን እናድርግ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ነበር። እርሱም። በማንም ግፍ አትሥሩ ማንንም በሐሰት አትክሰሱ፥ ደመወዛችሁም ይብቃችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of Yohanan, whether he were the Messiah, or not;
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሲጠብቁ ሳሉ ሁሉም በልባቸው ስለ ዮሐንስ። ይህ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? ብለው ሲያስቡ ነበር፥

verses.en: Yohanan answered, saying unto them all, I indeed immerse you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall immerse you with the Set-apart Spirit and with fire:
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔስ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የጫማውን ጠፍር መፍታት ከማይገባኝ ከእኔ የሚበረታ ይመጣል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስና በእሳት ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.am: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕዝቡን በብዙ ሌላ ምክር እየመከራቸው ወንጌልን ይሰብክላቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.am: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ ግን፥ ስለ ሄሮድያዳ ስለ ወንድሙ ስለ ፊልጶስ ሚስትና ሄሮድስ ስላደረገው ሌላ ክፋት ሁሉ ዮሐንስ ስለ ገሠጸው፥

verses.en: Added yet this above all, that he shut up Yohanan in prison.
verses.am: ይህን ደግሞ ከሁሉ በላይ ጨምሮ ዮሐንስን በወኅኒ አገባው።

verses.en: Now when all the people were immersed, it came to pass, that Yahushua also being immersed, and praying, the heaven was opened,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከተጠመቁ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ ተጠመቀ። ሲጸልይም ሰማይ ተከፈተ፥

verses.en: And the Set-apart Spirit descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.am: መንፈስ ቅዱስም በአካል መልክ እንደ ርግብ በእርሱ ላይ ወረደ፤ የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፥ በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል የሚል ድምፅም ከሰማይ መጣ።

verses.en: And Yahushua himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Yoseph, which was the son of Heli,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሊያስተምር ሲጀምር ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ዓመት ያህል ሆኖት ነበር እንደመሰላቸው የዮሴፍ ልጅ ሆኖ፥ የኤሊ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Yoseph,
verses.am: የማቲ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥ የሚልኪ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
verses.am: የዮና ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ፥ የአሞጽ ልጅ፥ የናሆም ልጅ፥ የኤሲሊም ልጅ

verses.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Yoseph, which was the son of Juda,
verses.am: የናጌ ልጅ፥ የማአት ልጅ፥ የማታትዩ ልጅ የሴሜይ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
verses.am: የዮዳ ልጅ፥ የዮናን ልጅ፥ የሬስ ልጅ፥ የዘሩባቤል ልጅ፥ የሰላትያል ልጅ፥ የኔሪ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
verses.am: የሚልኪ ልጅ፥ የሐዲ ልጅ፥ የዮሳስ ልጅ፥ የቆሳም ልጅ፥ የኤልሞዳም ልጅ፥ የኤር ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
verses.am: የዮሴዕ ልጅ፥ የኤልዓዘር ልጅ የዮራም ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Yoseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
verses.am: የስምዖን ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የዮሴፍ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of Dawid,
verses.am: የዮናን ልጅ፥ የኤልያቄም ልጅ፥ የሜልያ ልጅ፥ የማይናን ልጅ፥ የማጣት ልጅ፥ የናታን ልጅ

verses.en: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ፥ የእሴይ ልጅ፥ የኢዮቤድ ልጅ፥ የቦዔዝ ልጅ፥ የሰልሞን ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
verses.am: የነአሶን ልጅ፥ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ፥ የአራም ልጅ፥ የአሮኒ ልጅ፥ የኤስሮም ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Ya'aqob, which was the son of Yitschaq, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
verses.am: የፋሬስ ልጅ፥ የይሁዳ ልጅ፥ የያዕቆብ ልጅ፥ የይስሐቅ ልጅ፥ የአብርሃም ልጅ፥ የታራ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
verses.am: የናኮር ልጅ፥ የሴሮህ ልጅ፥ የራጋው ልጅ፥ የፋሌቅ ልጅ፥ የአቤር ልጅ፥ የሳላ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
verses.am: የቃይንም ልጅ፥ የአርፋክስድ ልጅ፥ የሴም ልጅ፥ የኖኅ ልጅ፥ የላሜህ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Hanok, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
verses.am: የማቱሳላ ልጅ፥ የሄኖክ ልጅ፥ የያሬድ ልጅ፥

verses.en: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የመላልኤል ልጅ፥ የቃይናን ልጅ፥ የሄኖስ ልጅ፥ የሴት ልጅ፥ የአዳም ልጅ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ።

verses.en: And Yahushua being full of the Set-apart Spirit returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መንፈስ ቅዱስ መልቶበት ከዮርዳኖስ ተመለሰ፥ በመንፈስም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ተመርቶ፥

verses.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.am: አርባ ቀን ከዲያብሎስ ተፈተነ። በነዚያም ቀኖች ምንም አልበላም፥ ከተጨረሱም በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.en: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of YAHUAH, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ ይህን ድንጋይ። እንጀራ ሁን ብለህ እዘዝ አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ አውጥቶ የዓለምን መንግሥታት ሁሉ በቅጽበት አሳየው።

verses.en: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.am: ዲያብሎስም። ይህ ሥልጣን ሁሉ ክብራቸውም ለእኔ ተሰጥቶአል ለምወደውም ለማንም እሰጠዋለሁና ለአንተ እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አንተ በእኔ ፊት ብትሰግድ፥ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Master thy YAHUAH, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ለጌታ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: And he brought him to Yerushalayim, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of YAHUAH, cast thyself down from hence:
For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደግሞ ወሰደው፤ በመቅደስም ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ። ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል፥ እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ከዚህ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ደግሞ ወሰደው፤ በመቅደስም ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ። ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል፥ እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ከዚህ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Master thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎአል አለው።

verses.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.am: ዲያቢሎስም ፈተናውን ሁሉ ከጨረሰ በኋላ እስከ ጊዜው ከእርሱ ተለየ።

verses.en: And Yahushua returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በመንፈስ ኃይል ወደ ገሊላ ተመለሰ፤ ስለ እርሱም በዙሪያው ባለችው አገር ሁሉ ዝና ወጣ።

verses.en: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.am: እርሱም በምኵራባቸው ያስተምር፥ ሁሉም ያመሰግኑት ነበር።

verses.en: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.am: ወዳደገበትም ወደ ናዝሬት መጣ፤ እንደ ልማዱም በሰንበት ቀን ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፥ ሊያነብም ተነሣ።

verses.en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

The Spirit of the Master is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.am: የነቢዩንም የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፥ መጽሐፉንም በተረተረ ጊዜ። የጌታ መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን ለዕውሮችም ማየትን እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ የተጠቁትንም ነጻ አወጣ ዘንድ የተወደደችውንም የጌታን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ልኮኛል ተብሎ የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።

verses.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Master.
verses.am: የነቢዩንም የኢሳይያስን መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፥ መጽሐፉንም በተረተረ ጊዜ። የጌታ መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች ወንጌልን እሰብክ ዘንድ ቀብቶኛልና፤ ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን ለዕውሮችም ማየትን እሰብክ ዘንድ፥ የተጠቁትንም ነጻ አወጣ ዘንድ የተወደደችውንም የጌታን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ልኮኛል ተብሎ የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።

verses.en: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.am: መጽሐፉንም ጠቅልሎ ለአገልጋዩ ሰጠውና ተቀመጠ፤ በምኵራብም የነበሩት ሁሉ ትኵር ብለው ይመለከቱት ነበር።

verses.en: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.am: እርሱም። ዛሬ ይህ መጽሐፍ በጆሮአችሁ ተፈጸመ ይላቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Yoseph's son?
verses.am: ሁሉም ይመሰክሩለት ነበር ከአፉም ከሚወጣው ከጸጋው ቃል የተነሣ እየተደነቁ። ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ አይደለምን? ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.am: እርሱም። ያለ ጥርጥር ይህን ምሳሌ። ባለ መድኃኒት ሆይ፥ ራስህን ፈውስ፤ በቅፍርናሆም እንዳደረግኸው የሰማነውን ሁሉ በዚህ በገዛ አገርህ ደግሞ አድርግ ትሉኛላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ ከቶ አይወደድም።

verses.en: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Yisra'el in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በኤልያስ ዘመን ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ሰማይ ተዘግቶ ሳለ በምድር ሁሉ ብርቱ ራብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በእስራኤል ብዙ መበለቶች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.am: ኤልያስም በሲዶና አገር ወዳለች ወደ ሰራፕታ ወደ አንዲት መበለት እንጂ ከእነርሱ ወደ አንዲቱ አልተላከም።

verses.en: And many lepers were in Yisra'el in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኤልሳዕ ዘመንም በእስራኤል ብዙ ለምጻሞች ነበሩ፥ ከሶርያዊው ከንዕማን በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ስንኳ አልነጻም።

verses.en: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.am: በምኵራብም የነበሩ ሁሉ ይህን ሰምተው ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ ተነሥተውም ከከተማ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥

verses.en: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.am: ይጥሉትም ዘንድ ከተማቸው ተሠርታባት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ተራራው አፋፍ ወሰዱት፤

verses.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
verses.am: እርሱ ግን በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.am: ወደ ገሊላ ከተማም ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ። በሰንበትም ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.am: ቃሉ በሥልጣን ነበርና በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.am: በምኵራብም የርኵስ ጋኔን መንፈስ ያደረበት ሰው ነበረ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኾ።

verses.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Yahushua of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ተው፥ የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ልታጠፋን መጣህን? ማን እንደ ሆንህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሱ አለ።

verses.en: And Yahushua rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ዝም በል ከእርሱም ውጣ ብሎ ገሠጸው። ጋኔኑም በመካከላቸው ጥሎት ሳይጐዳው ከእርሱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.am: ሁሉንም መደነቅ ያዛቸው፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? በሥልጣንና በኃይል ርኵሳን መናፍስትን ያዝዛልና፥ ይወጡማል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.am: ዝናም በዙሪያው ባለች አገር ወደ ስፍራው ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ ወጣ።

verses.en: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.am: በምኵራብም ተነሥቶ ወደ ስምዖን ቤት ገባ። የስምዖንም አማት በብርቱ ንዳድ ታማ ነበር ስለ እርስዋም ለመኑት።

verses.en: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.am: በአጠገብዋም ቆሞ ንዳዱን ገሠጸውና ለቀቃት፤ ያንጊዜውንም ተነሥታ አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.en: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.am: ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌ የተያዙ በሽተኞችን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡአቸው፤ እርሱም በእያንዳቸው ላይ እጁን ጭኖ ፈወሳቸው።

verses.en: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Messiah the Son of YAHUAH. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Messiah.
verses.am: አጋንንትም ደግሞ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ እያሉ እየጮኹም ከብዙዎች ይወጡ ነበር፤ ገሠጻቸውም ክርስቶስም እንደ ሆነ አውቀውት ነበርና እንዲናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.en: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.am: በጸባም ጊዜ ወጥቶ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሄደ፤ ሕዝቡም ይፈልጉት ነበር፤ ወደ እርሱም መጡ፥ ከእነርሱም ተለይቶ እንዳይሄድ ሊከለክሉት ወደዱ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of YAHUAH to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ስለዚህ ተልኬአለሁና ለሌሎቹ ከተማዎች ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ወንጌል እሰብክ ዘንድ ይገባኛል አላቸው።

verses.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.am: በገሊላም ምኵራቦች ይሰብክ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of YAHUAH, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እየሰሙ ሲያስጠብቡት ሳሉ፥ እርሱ ራሱ በጌንሳሬጥ ባሕር ዳር ቆሞ ነበር፤

verses.en: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.am: በባሕር ዳርም ቆመው የነበሩትን ሁለት ታንኳዎች አየ፤ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ግን ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ወጥተው መረቦቻቸውን ያጥቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.am: ከታንኳዎቹም የስምዖን ወደ ነበረች ወደ አንዲቱ ገብቶ ከምድር ጥቂት ፈቀቅ እንዲያደርጋት ለመነው፤ በታንኳይቱም ተቀምጦ ሕዝቡን ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.en: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.am: ነገሩንም ከጨረሰ በኋላ፥ ስምዖንን። ወደ ጥልቁ ፈቀቅ በል መረቦቻችሁንም ለማጥመድ ጣሉ አለው።

verses.en: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.am: ስምዖንም መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አድረን ስንደክም ምንም አልያዝንም፤ ነገር ግን በቃልህ መረቦቹን እጥላለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.am: ይህንም ባደረጉ ጊዜ እጅግ ብዙ ዓሣ ያዙ፤ መረቦቻቸውም ተቀደዱ።

verses.en: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.am: በሌላ ታንኳም የነበሩትን ጓደኞቻቸውን መጥተው እንዲያግዙአቸው ጠቀሱ፤ መጥተውም ሁለቱ ታንኳዎች እስኪሰጥሙ ድረስ ሞሉአቸው።

verses.en: When Simon Kepha saw it, he fell down at Yahushua's knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Master.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ግን ባየ ጊዜ በኢየሱስ ጕልበት ላይ ወድቆ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ ኃጢአተኛ ነኝና ከኔ ተለይ አለው።

verses.en: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.am: ስላጠመዱት ዓሣ እርሱ ከእርሱ ጋርም የነበሩ ሁሉ ተደንቀዋልና፥

verses.en: And so was also Ya'aqob, and Yohanan, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Yahushua said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ደግሞ የስምዖን ባልንጀሮች የነበሩ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ተደነቁ። ኢየሱስም ስምዖንን። አትፍራ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሰውን የምታጠምድ ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.en: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.am: ታንኳዎችንም ወደ ምድር አድርሰው ሁሉን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahushua fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Master, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.am: ከከተማዎችም በአንዲቱ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ለምጽ የሞላበት ሰው ነበረ፤ ኢየሱስንም አይቶ በፊቱ ወደቀና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ፥ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.am: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው፤ ወዲያውም ለምጹ ለቀቀው።

verses.en: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Mosheh commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.am: እርሱም ለማንም እንዳይናገር አዘዘው፥ ነገር ግን። ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ስለ መንጻትህ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘ መሥዋዕት አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.am: ወሬው ግን አብዝቶ ወጣ፥ ብዙ ሕዝብም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እርሱ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Yerushalayim: and the power of the Master was present to heal them.
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም ያስተምር ነበር፤ ከገሊላና ከይሁዳ መንደሮችም ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው የነበሩ ፈሪሳውያንና የሕግ መምህራን ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ እርሱም እንዲፈውስ የጌታ ኃይል ሆነለት።

verses.en: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሽባ በአልጋ ተሸክመው አመጡ፤ አግብተውም በፊቱ ሊያኖሩት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Yahushua.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ብዛት እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያገቡት ሲያቅታቸው፥ ወደ ሰገነቱ ወጡ የጣራውንም ጡብ አሳልፈው በመካከል በኢየሱስ ፊት ከነአልጋው አወረዱት።

verses.en: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.am: እምነታቸውንም አይቶ። አንተ ሰው፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but YAHUAH alone?
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም። ይህ የሚሳደብ ማን ነው? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ማን ይችላል? ብለው ያስቡ ጀመር።

verses.en: But when Yahushua perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን እያወቀ መልሶ። በልባችሁ ምን ታስባላችሁ?

verses.en: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.am: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአት ሊያስተሰርይ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ ብሎ፥ ሽባውን። አንተን እልሃለሁ፥ ነተሣ፥ አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም በፊታቸው ተነሣ፥ ተኝቶበትም የነበረውን ተሸክሞ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And they were all amazed, and they glorified YAHUAH, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.am: ሁሉንም መገረም ያዛቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመስግነው። ዛሬስ ድንቅ ነገር አየን እያሉ ፍርሃት ሞላባቸው።

verses.en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ወጥቶ ሌዊ የሚባል ቀራጭ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ ተመለከተና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ተወ፤ ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.am: ሌዊም በቤቱ ታላቅ ግብዣ አደረገለት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩ ከቀራጮችና ከሌሎች ሰዎች ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ጻፎቻቸውም በደቀ መዛሙርቱ ላይ። ስለ ምን ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ትበላላችሁ ትጠጡማላችሁ? ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.en: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of Yohanan fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.am: እነርሱም። የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን ብዙ ይጦማሉ ጸሎትስ ስለ ምን ያደርጋሉ፥ ደግሞም የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት ስለ ምን እንደዚሁ ያደርጋሉ፤ የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ይበላሉ ይጠጣሉም? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሚዜዎችን ልታስጦሙ ትችላላችሁን?

verses.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወራት ይመጣል፥ ሙሽራውም ከእነርሱ ሲወሰድ ያንጊዜ፥ በዚያ ወራት ይጦማሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.am: ደግሞም ምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ነገራቸው። የአዲስ ልብስ እራፊ ባረጀ ልብስ ላይ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱን ይቀደዋል ደግሞም አዲስ እራፊ ለአሮጌው አይስማማውም።

verses.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.am: ባረጀ አቁማዳም አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን አዲሱ የወይን ጠጅ አቁማዳውን ያፈነዳል፥ እርሱም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል።

verses.en: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.am: አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ ግን በአዲስ አቁማዳ ማኖር ይገባል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.am: አሮጌ የወይን ጠጅ ሲጠጣ አዲሱን የሚሻ ማንም የለም፤ አሮጌው ይጣፍጣል ይላልና።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.am: በሰንበትም በእርሻ መካከል ያልፍ ነበር ደቀ መዛሙርቱም እሸት ይቀጥፉ በእጃቸውም እያሹ ይበሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያን ግን አንዳንዶቹ። በሰንበት ሊያደርግ ያልተፈቀደውን ስለ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what Dawid did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
How he went into the house of YAHUAH, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለእነርሱ መልሶ። ዳዊት በተራበ ጊዜ እርሱ አብረውት ከነበሩ ጋር ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ከካህናት ብቻ በቀር መብላቱ ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕትን እንጀራ ይዞ እንደ በላ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት ደግሞ እንደ ሰጣቸው ይህን አላነበባችሁምን? አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Master also of the sabbath.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነው አላቸውም።

verses.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.am: በሌላው ሰንበትም ወደ ምኵራብ ገብቶ አስተማረ፤ በዚያም ቀኝ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም መክሰሻ ሊያገኙበት በሰንበት ይፈውስ እንደ ሆነ ይጠባበቁት ነበር።

verses.en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እጁ የሰለለችውን ሰው። ተነሣና በመካከል ቁም አለው፤ ተነሥቶም ቆመ።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ በሰንበት በጎ ማድረግ ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ ክፉ? ነፍስ ማዳንን ወይስ መግደል? አላቸው።

verses.en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.am: ሁላቸውንም ዙሪያውን አየና ሰውዬውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ አደረገ፥ እጁም እንደ ሁለተኛይቱ ዳነች።

verses.en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Yahushua.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቍጣ ሞላባቸው፥ በኢየሱስም ምን እንዲያደርጉበት እርስ በርሳቸው ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to YAHUAH.
verses.am: በነዚህም ወራት ይጸልይ ዘንድ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጸልይ አደረ።

verses.en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠራ፥ ከእነርሱም አሥራ ሁለት መረጠ ደግሞም ሐዋርያት ብሎ ሰየማቸው፤

verses.en: Simon, (whom he also named Kepha,) and Andrew his brother, Ya'aqob and Yohanan, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.am: እነርሱም፥ ጴጥሮስ ብሎ እንደ ገና የሰየመው ስምዖን፥ ወንድሙም እንድርያስ፥ ያዕቆብም ዮሐንስም፥ ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥

verses.en: Mattithyahu and Thomas, Ya'aqob the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.am: ማቴዎስም ቶማስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ቀናተኛ የሚባለው ስምዖንም፥

verses.en: And Judas the brother of Ya'aqob, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ይሁዳም፥ አሳልፎ የሰጠውም የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ናቸው።

verses.en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Yerushalayim, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ወርዶ በተካከለ ስፍራ ቆመ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወገን ብዙ ሕዝብ ነበረ፥ ደግሞም ሊሰሙትና ከደዌአቸው ሊፈወሱ ከይሁዳ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከጢሮስና ከሲዶና ባሕር ዳርም የመጡ ብዙ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.am: ከርኵሳንም መናፍስት ይሠቃዩ የነበሩት ተፈወሱ፤

verses.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ኃይል ወጥቶ ሁሉን ይፈውስ ነበርና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሊዳስሱት ይሹ ነበር።

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እርሱም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዓይኑን አነሣ እንዲህም አላቸው። እናንተ ድሆች ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የእናንተ ነውና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.am: እናንተ አሁን የምትራቡ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትጠግባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምታለቅሱ ብፁዓን ናችሁ፥ ትስቃላችሁና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.am: ሰዎች ስለ ሰው ልጅ ሲጠሉአችሁ ሲለዩአችሁም ሲነቅፉአችሁም ስማችሁንም እንደ ክፉ ሲያወጡ፥ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ዋጋችሁ በሰማይ ታላቅ ነውና በዚያን ቀን ደስ ይበላችሁ ዝለሉም፤ አባቶቻቸው ነቢያትን እንዲህ ያደርጉባቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ባለ ጠጎች ወዮላችሁ፥ መጽናናታችሁን ተቀብላችኋልና።

verses.en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.am: እናንተ አሁን የጠገባችሁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ትራባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምትስቁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ታዝናላችሁና ታለቅሱማላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ መልካም ሲናገሩላችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለሐሰተኞች ነቢያት እንዲሁ ያደርጉላቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእናንተ ለምትሰሙ እላችኋለሁ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁ መልካም አድርጉ፥

verses.en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.am: የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ስለሚበድሉአችሁም ጸልዩ።

verses.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.am: ጕንጭህን ለሚመታህ ደግሞ ሁለተኛውን ስጠው፥ መጐናጸፊያህንም ለሚወስድ እጀ ጠባብህን ደግሞ አትከልክለው።

verses.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.am: ለሚለምንህ ሁሉ ስጥ፥ ገንዘብህንም የሚወስድ እንዲመልስ አትጠይቀው።

verses.en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ሊያደርጉላችሁ እንደምትወዱ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው።

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.am: የሚወዱአችሁንማ ብትወዱ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ የሚወዱአቸውን ይወዳሉና።

verses.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.am: መልካምም ለሚያደርጉላችሁ መልካም ብታደርጉ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ ያን ያደርጋሉና።

verses.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.am: እንድትወስዱባቸው ተስፋ ለምታደርጉአቸው ብታበድሩ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ በትክክል እንዲቀበሉ ለኃጢአተኞች ያበድራሉ።

verses.en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ መልካም አድርጉ፤ ምንም ተስፋ ሳታደርጉም አበድሩ፥ ዋጋችሁም ታላቅ ይሆናል፥ የልዑልም ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ፥ እርሱ ለማያመሰግኑ ለክፉዎችም ቸር ነውና።

verses.en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.am: አባታችሁ ርኅሩኅ እንደ ሆነ ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ።

verses.en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.am: አትፍረዱ አይፈረድባችሁምም፤ አትኰንኑ አትኰነኑምም። ይቅር በሉ ይቅርም ትባላላችሁ።

verses.en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.am: ስጡ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ በምትሰፍሩበት መስፈሪያ ተመልሶ ይሰፈርላችኋልና፥ የተጨቈነና የተነቀነቀ የተትረፈረፈም መልካም መስፈሪያ በእቅፋችሁ ይሰጣችኋል።

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.am: ምሳሌም አላቸው። ዕውር ዕውርን ሊመራ ይችላልን? ሁለቱ በጕድጓድ አይወድቁምን?

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ አይበልጥም፤ ፈጽሞ የተማረ ሁሉ ግን እንደ መምህሩ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.am: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለ ምን ታያለህ፥ በራስህ ዓይን ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.am: በዓይንህ ያለውን ምሰሶ ራስህ ሳታይ፥ እንዴት ወንድምህን። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ በዓይንህ ያለውን ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ ልትል ትችላለህ? አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ ከዚያም በኋላ በወንድምህ ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.am: ክፉ ፍሬ የሚያደርግ መልካም ዛፍ የለምና፥ እንዲሁም መልካም ፍሬ የሚያደርግ ክፉ ዛፍ የለም።

verses.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.am: ዛፍ ሁሉ ከፍሬው ይታወቃልና፤ ከእሾህ በለስ አይለቅሙም፥ ከአጣጥ ቍጥቋጦም ወይን አይቈርጡም።

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.am: በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፉ ይናገራልና መልካም ሰው ከልብ መልካም መዝገብ መልካሙን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከልብ ክፉ መዝገብ ክፉውን ያወጣል።

verses.en: And why call ye me, Master, Master, and do not the things which I say?
verses.am: ስለ ምን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ትሉኛላችሁ፥ የምለውንም አታደርጉም?

verses.en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.am: ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ሁሉ ቃሌንም ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው፥ ማንን እንዲመስል አሳያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.am: ቤት ሲሠራ አጥልቆ የቆፈረ በዓለት ላይም የመሠረተ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ጐርፍም በመጣ ጊዜ ወንዙ ያን ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ ሊያናውጠው አልቻለም።

verses.en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.am: ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ግን ያለ መሠረት በምድር ላይ ቤቱን የሠራ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ወንዙም ገፋው ወዲያውም ወደቀ የዚያ ቤት አወዳደቅም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.am: ቃሉን ሁሉ በሕዝብ ጆሮዎች በጨረሰ ጊዜ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ገባ።

verses.en: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.am: አንድ የመቶ አለቃም ነበረ፤ የሚወደውም ባሪያው ታሞ ሊሞት ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he heard of Yahushua, he sent unto him the elders of the Yehudim, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.am: ስለ ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ የአይሁድን ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ላከና መጥቶ ባሪያውን እንዲያድን ለመነው።

verses.en: And when they came to Yahushua, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.am: እነርሱም ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥተው። ይህን ልታደርግለት ይገባዋል፤

verses.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.am: ሕዝባችንን ይወዳልና ምኵራብም ራሱ ሠርቶልናል ብለው አጽንተው ለመኑት።

verses.en: Then Yahushua went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Master, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄደ። አሁንም ወደ ቤቱ በቀረበ ጊዜ የመቶው አለቃ ወዳጆቹን ወደ እርሱ ላከ፤ አለውም። ጌታ ሆይ በቤቴ ጣራ በታች ልትገባ አይገባኝምና አትድከም፤

verses.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ወደ አንተ ልመጣ እንዲገባኝ ሰውነቴን አልቈጠርሁትም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ከሌሎች በታች የምገዛ ሰው ነኝ፥ ከእኔም በታች ወታደሮች አሉኝ፥ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል።

verses.en: When Yahushua heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yisra'el.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ በእርሱ ተደነቀ፥ ዘወርም ብሎ ለተከተሉት ሕዝብ። እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤልስ እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.am: የተላኩትም ወደ ቤት ተመልሰው ባሪያውን ባለ ጤና ሆኖ አገኙት።

verses.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.am: በነገውም ናይን ወደምትባል ወደ አንዲት ከተማ ሄደ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙ ሕዝብም ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ሄዱ።

verses.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.am: ወደ ከተማይቱም በር በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የሞተ ሰው ተሸክመው አወጡ፤ እርሱም ለእናቱ አንድ ልጅ ነበረ፥ እርስዋም መበለት ነበረች፥ ብዙም የከተማ ሕዝብ ከእርስዋ ጋር አብረው ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when the Master saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.am: ጌታም ባያት ጊዜ አዘነላትና። አታልቅሽ አላት።

verses.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.am: ቀርቦም ቃሬዛውን ነካ፥ የተሸከሙትም ቆሙ፤ አለውም። አንተ ጐበዝ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.am: የሞተውም ቀና ብሎ ተቀመጠ ሊናገርም ጀመረ፥ ለእናቱም ሰጣት።

verses.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified YAHUAH, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That YAHUAH hath visited his people.
verses.am: ሁሉንም ፍርሃት ያዛቸውና። ታላቅ ነቢይ በእኛ መካከል ተነሥቶአል፥ ደግሞ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጐበኘ እያሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.am: ይህም ዝና ስለ እርሱ በይሁዳ ሁሉ በዙሪያውም ባለች አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the disciples of Yohanan shewed him of all these things.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለዮሐንስ እነዚህን ሁሉ አወሩ።

verses.en: And Yohanan calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Yahushua, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.am: ዮሐንስም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ ኢየሱስ ላከ።

verses.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, Yohanan Immerser hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.am: ሰዎቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው። መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን ወይስ ሌላውን እንጠብቅ? ብሎ ወደ አንተ ላከን አሉት።

verses.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.am: በዚያች ሰዓት ከደዌና ከሥቃይ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትም ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፥ ለብዙ ዕውሮችም ማየትን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Then Yahushua answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell Yohanan what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤ ዕውሮች ያያሉ፥ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ፥ ደንቆሮዎችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ፥ ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.am: በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And when the messengers of Yohanan were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning Yohanan, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ መልክተኞችም ከሄዱ በኋላ፥ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ይናገር ጀመር እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ? ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.am: ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰውን ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስ የሚለብሱና በቅምጥልነት የሚኖሩ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.am: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than Yohanan the Immerser: but he that is least in the kingdom of YAHUAH is greater than he.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ ማንም የለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified YAHUAH, being immersed with the immersion of Yohanan.
verses.am: የሰሙትም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ቀራጮች እንኳ ሳይቀሩ በዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ተጠምቀው እግዚአብሔርን አጸደቁ፤

verses.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of YAHUAH against themselves, being not immersed of him.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ሕግ አዋቂዎች ግን በእርሱ ስለ አልተጠመቁ የእግዚአብሔርን ምክር ከራሳቸው ጣሉ።

verses.en: And the Master said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የዚችን ትውልድ ሰዎች በምን አስመስላቸዋለሁ? ማንንስ ይመስላሉ?

verses.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.am: በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም እየተጠራሩ። እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ አልዘፈናችሁምም፤ ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ አላለቀሳችሁምም ይላል።

verses.en: For Yohanan the Immerser came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.am: መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ እንጀራ ሳይበላ የወይን ጠጅም ሳይጠጣ መጥቶ ነበርና። ጋኔን አለበት አላችሁት።

verses.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጥቶአልና። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ አላችሁት።

verses.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.am: ጥበብም ለልጆችዋ ሁሉ ጸደቀች።

verses.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንድ ከእርሱ ጋር ይበላ ዘንድ ለመነው፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤትም ገብቶ በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Yahushua sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.am: እነሆም በዚያች ከተማ ኃጢአተኛ የነበረች አንዲት ሴት፤ በፈሪሳዊው ቤት በማዕድ እንደ ተቀመጠ ባወቀች ጊዜ፥ ሽቱ የሞላበት የአልባስጥሮስ ቢልቃጥ አመጣች።

verses.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.am: በስተ ኋላውም በእግሩ አጠገብ ቆማ እያለቀሰች በእንባዋ እግሩን ታርስ ጀመረች፥ በራስ ጠጕርዋም ታብሰው እግሩንም ትስመው ሽቱም ትቀባው ነበረች።

verses.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.am: የጠራው ፈሪሳዊም አይቶ። ይህስ ነቢይ ቢሆን፥ ይህች የምትዳስሰው ሴት ማን እንደ ሆነች እንዴትስ እንደ ነበረች ባወቀ ነበር፥ ኃጢአተኛ ናትና ብሎ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ የምነግርህ ነገር አለኝ አለው። እርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ተናገር አለ።

verses.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.am: ለአንድ አበዳሪ ሁለት ተበዳሪዎች ነበሩት በአንዱ አምስት መቶ ዲናር ነበረበት በሁለተኛውም አምሳ።

verses.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.am: የሚከፍሉትም ቢያጡ ለሁለቱም ተወላቸው። እንግዲህ ከእነርሱ አብልጦ የሚወደው ማንኛው ነው?

verses.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.am: ስምዖንም መልሶ። ብዙ የተወለቱ ይመስለኛል አለ። እርሱም። በእውነት ፈረድህ አለው።

verses.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.am: ወደ ሴቲቱም ዘወር ብሎ ስምዖንን እንዲህ አለው። ይህችን ሴት ታያለህን? እኔ ወደ ቤትህ ገባሁ፥ ውኃ ስንኳ ለእግሬ አላቀረብህልኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን በእንባዋ እግሬን አራሰች በጠጕርዋም አበሰች።

verses.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.am: አንተ አልሳምኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን ከገባሁ ጀምራ እግሬን ከመሳም አላቋረጠችም።

verses.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.am: አንተ ራሴን ዘይት አልቀባኸኝም፤ እርስዋ ግን እግሬን ሽቱ ቀባች።

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እልሃለሁ፥ እጅግ ወዳለችና ብዙ ያለው ኃጢአትዋ ተሰርዮላታል፤ ጥቂት ግን የሚሰረይለት ጥቂት ይወዳል።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.am: እርስዋንም። ኃጢአትሽ ተሰርዮልሻል አላት።

verses.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጠው የነበሩት በልባቸው። ኃጢአትን እንኳ የሚያስተሰርይ ይህ ማን ነው? ይሉ ጀመር።

verses.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.am: ሴቲቱንም። እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

verses.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of YAHUAH: and the twelve were with him,
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ እየሰበከና ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት የምሥራች እየተናገረ በየከተማይቱ በየመንደሩም ያልፍ ነበር፤

verses.en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Miryam called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፥ ከክፉዎች መናፍስትና ከደዌም ተፈውሰው የነበሩ አንዳንድ ሴቶች፤ እነርሱም ሰባት አጋንንት የወጡላት መግደላዊት የምትባል ማርያም፥

verses.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.am: የሄሮድስ አዛዥ የኩዛ ሚስት ዮሐናም ሶስናም ብዙዎች ሌሎችም ሆነው በገንዘባቸው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ከከተማዎችም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በምሳሌ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.am: ዘሪ ዘሩን ሊዘራ ወጣ። ሲዘራም አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ ተረገጠም፥ የሰማይ ወፎችም በሉት።

verses.en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.am: ሌላውም በዓለት ላይ ወደቀ፥ በበቀለም ጊዜ እርጥበት ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.am: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾሁም አብሮ በቀለና አነቀው።

verses.en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.am: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ላይ ወደቀ፤ በበቀለም ጊዜ መቶ እጥፍ አፈራ። ይህን በተናገረ ጊዜ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህ ምሳሌ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of YAHUAH: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ። ለእናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፤ ለሌሎች ግን እያዩ እንዳያዩ እየሰሙም እንዳያስተውሉ በምሳሌ ነው።

verses.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ምሳሌው ይህ ነው። ዘሩ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.am: በመንገድ ዳርም ያሉት የሚሰሙ ናቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላም ዲያብሎስ ይመጣል አምነውም እንዳይድኑ ቃሉን ከልባቸው ይወስዳል።

verses.en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.am: በዓለት ላይም ያሉት ሲሰሙ ቃሉን በደስታ የሚቀበሉ ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ለጊዜው ብቻ ያምናሉ እንጂ በፈተና ጊዜ የሚክዱ ሥር የሌላቸው ናቸው።

verses.en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.am: በእሾህ መካከልም የወደቀ እነዚህ የሚሰሙት ናቸው፤ መንገዳቸውንም ሄደው በሕይወት ዘመን በአሳብና በባለ ጠግነት ምቾት ይታነቃሉ፥ ሙሉ ፍሬም አያፈሩም።

verses.en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.am: በመልካም መሬት ላይም የወደቀ እነርሱ በመልካምና በበጎ ልብ ቃሉን ሰምተው የሚጠብቁት በመጽናትም ፍሬ የሚያፈሩ ናቸው።

verses.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.am: መብራትንም አብርቶ በዕቃ የሚከድነው ወይም ከአልጋ በታች የሚያኖረው የለም፥ የሚገቡት ሰዎች ብርሃኑን እንዲያዩ በመቅረዝ ላይ ያኖረዋል እንጂ።

verses.en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.am: የማይገለጥ የተሰወረ የለምና፥ የማይታወቅም ወደ ግልጥም የማይመጣ የተሸሸገ የለም።

verses.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንድትሰሙ ተጠበቁ፤ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋልና፥ ከሌለውም ሁሉ፥ ያው ያለው የሚመስለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.am: እናቱና ወንድሞቹም ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ ከሕዝቡም ብዛት የተነሣ ሊያገኙት አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.am: እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊያዩህ ወድደው በውጭ ቆመዋል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of YAHUAH, and do it.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። እናቴና ወንድሞቼስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሰምተው የሚያደርጉት እነዚህ ናቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.am: ከዕለታቱም በአንዱ እርሱ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳ ገብቶ። ወደ ባሕር ማዶ እንሻገር አላቸው፤ ተነሡም።

verses.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.am: ሲሄዱም አንቀላፋ። ዓውሎ ነፋስም በባሕር ላይ ወረደ፥ ውኃውም ታንኳይቱን ይሞላ ነበርና ይጨነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.am: ቀርበውም። አቤቱ፥ አቤቱ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት። እርሱም ነቅቶ ነፋሱንና የውኃውን ማዕበል ገሠጻቸው፤ ተዉም፥ ጽጥታም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.am: እርሱም። እምነታችሁ የት ነው? አላቸው። ፈርተውም ተደነቁ፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንዲህ ነፋሳትንና ውኃን እንኳ የሚያዝ ለእርሱም የሚታዘዙለት ይህ ማን ነው? አሉ።

verses.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.am: በገሊላም አንጻር ወዳለችው ወደ ጌርጌሴኖን አገር በታንኳ ደረሱ።

verses.en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.am: ወደ ምድርም በወጣ ጊዜ አጋንንት ያደሩበት አንድ ሰው ከከተማ ወጥቶ ተገናኘው፥ ከብዙ ዘመንም ጀምሮ ልብስ ሳይለብስ በመቃብር እንጂ በቤት አይኖርም ነበር።

verses.en: When he saw Yahushua, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Yahushua, thou Son of YAHUAH most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም ባየ ጊዜ ጮኾ በፊቱ ተደፋ በታላቅ ድምፅም። የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? እንዳትሣቀየኝ እለምንሃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.am: ርኵሱን መንፈስ ከሰውዬው እንዲወጣ ያዘው ነበርና። ብዙ ዘመንም ይዞት ነበርና፥ በሰንሰለትና በእግር ብረትም ታስሮ ይጠበቅ ነበር፤ እስራቱንም ሰብሮ በጋኔኑ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይነዳ ነበር።

verses.en: And Yahushua asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስምህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም ብዙዎች አጋንንት ገብተውበት ነበርና። ሌጌዎን አለው።

verses.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.am: ወደ ጥልቁም ሊሄዱ እንዳያዛቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.am: በዚያም በተራራው የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማሩ ነበር፤ ወደ እነርሱም ሊገቡ እንዲፈቅድላቸው ለመኑት፤ ፈቀደላቸውም።

verses.en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.am: አጋንንትም ከሰውዬው ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎች ገቡ፥ መንጋውም ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር ተጣደፉና ሰጠሙ።
