verses.en: And the Master said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.am: ጌታም አለ። የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ሾላ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተተከል ብትሉት፥ ይታዘዝላችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.am: ከእናንተም የሚያርስ ወይም ከብትን የሚጠብቅ ባሪያ ያለው፥ ከእርሻ ሲመለስ። ወዲያው ቅረብና በማዕድ ተቀመጥ የሚለው ማን ነው?

verses.en: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.am: የምበላውን እራቴን አሰናዳልኝ፥ እስክበላና እስክጠጣ ድረስ ታጥቀህ አገልግለኝ፥ በኋላም አንተ ብላና ጠጣ የሚለው አይደለምን?

verses.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.am: ያንን ባሪያ ያዘዘውን ስላደረገ ያመሰግነዋልን?

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ የታዘዛችሁትን ሁሉ ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ። የማንጠቅም ባሪያዎች ነን፥ ልናደርገው የሚገባንን አድርገናል በሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he went to Yerushalayim, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሲሄድ በገሊላና በሰማርያ መካከል አለፈ።

verses.en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.am: ወደ አንዲት መንደርም ሲገባ በሩቅ የቆሙት አሥር ለምጻሞች ተገናኙት፤

verses.en: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Yahushua, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.am: እነርሱም እየጮኹ። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን አሉ።

verses.en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.am: አይቶም። ሂዱ፥ ራሳችሁን ለካህናት አሳዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified YAHUAH,
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሲሄዱ ነጹ። ከእነርሱም አንዱ እንደ ተፈወሰ ባየ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን እያከበረ ተመለሰ፥

verses.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.am: እያመሰገነውም በእግሩ ፊት በግንባሩ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም ሳምራዊ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሥሩ አልነጹምን? ዘጠኙስ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to YAHUAH, save this stranger.
verses.am: ከዚህ ከልዩ ወገን በቀር እግዚአብሔርን ሊያከብሩ የተመለሱ አልተገኙም አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.am: እርሱንም። ተነሣና ሂድ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of YAHUAH should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of YAHUAH cometh not with observation:
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መቼ ትመጣለች ብለው ቢጠይቁት፥ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመጠባበቅ አትመጣም፤

verses.en: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of YAHUAH is within you.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እንኋት በዚህ ወይም። እንኋት በዚያ አይሉአትም። እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመካከላችሁ ናትና አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
verses.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አለ። ከሰው ልጅ ቀኖች አንዱን ልታዩ የምትመኙበት ወራት ይመጣል አታዩትምም።

verses.en: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እነሆ በዚህ፥ ወይም። እነሆ በዚያ ይሉአችኋል፤ አትሂዱ አትከተሉአቸውም።

verses.en: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.am: መብረቅ በርቆ ከሰማይ በታች ካለ ከአንድ አገር ከሰማይ በታች ወዳለው ወደ ሌላ አገር እንደሚያበራ፥ የሰው ልጅ በቀኑ እንዲህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ግን ብዙ መከራ እንዲቀበል ከዚህም ትውልድ እንዲጣል ይገባዋል።

verses.en: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.am: በኖኅ ዘመንም እንደ ሆነ፥ በሰው ልጅ ዘመን ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.am: ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከ ገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ይበሉና ይጠጡ ያገቡና ይጋቡም ነበር፥ የጥፋት ውኃም መጣ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.am: እንዲሁ በሎጥ ዘመን እንደ ሆነ፤ ይበሉ ይጠጡም ይገዙም ይሸጡም ይተክሉም ቤትም ይሠሩ ነበር፤

verses.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
verses.am: ሎጥ ከሰዶም በወጣበት ቀን ግን ከሰማይ እሳትና ዲን ዘነበ ሁሉንም አጠፋ።

verses.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ በሚገለጥበት ቀን እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በሰገነት ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ዕቃ ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥ እንዲሁም በእርሻ ያለ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.en: Remember Lot's wife.
verses.am: የሎጥን ሚስት አስቡአት።

verses.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚፈልግ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ በሕይወት ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ በዚያች ሌሊት ሁለት ሰዎች በአንድ አልጋ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.am: ሁለት ሴቶች በአንድ ወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች ሁለተኛይቱም ትቀራለች።

verses.en: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.am: ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል ሁለተኛውም ይቀራል።

verses.en: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Master? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። እርሱም። ሥጋ ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
verses.am: ሳይታክቱም ዘወትር ሊጸልዩ እንዲገባቸው የሚል ምሳሌን ነገራቸው፥

verses.en: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not YAHUAH, neither regarded man:
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲል። በአንዲት ከተማ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ ሰውንም የማያፍር አንድ ዳኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
verses.am: በዚያችም ከተማ አንዲት መበለት ነበረች፥ ወደ እርሱም እየመጣች። ከባላጋራዬ ፍረድልኝ ትለው ነበር።

verses.en: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not YAHUAH, nor regard man;
verses.am: አያሌ ቀንም አልወደደም፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ግን በልቡ። ምንም እግዚአብሔርን ባልፈራ ሰውንም ባላፍር፥

verses.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.am: ይህች መበለት ስለምታደክመኝ ሁልጊዜም እየመጣች እንዳታውከኝ እፈርድላታለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the Master said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
verses.am: ጌታም አለ። ዓመፀኛው ዳኛ ያለውን ስሙ።

verses.en: And shall not YAHUAH avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንኪያስ ቀንና ሌሊት ወደ እርሱ ለሚጮኹ ለሚታገሣቸውም ምርጦቹ አይፈርድላቸውምን?

verses.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ፈጥኖ ይፈርድላቸዋል። ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ በመጣ ጊዜ በምድር እምነትን ያገኝ ይሆንን?

verses.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.am: ጻድቃን እንደ ሆኑ በራሳቸው ለሚታመኑና ሌሎቹን ሁሉ በጣም ለሚንቁ ይህን ምሳሌ ነገራቸው፥

verses.en: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲል። ሁለት ሰዎች ሊጸልዩ ወደ መቅደስ ወጡ፥ አንዱ ፈሪሳዊ ሁለተኛውም ቀራጭ።

verses.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, YAHUAH, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.am: ፈሪሳዊም ቆሞ በልቡ ይህን ሲጸልይ። እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እንደ ሌላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ ቀማኞችና ዓመፀኞች አመንዝሮችም፥ ወይም እንደዚህ ቀራጭ ስላልሆንሁ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.am: በየሳምንቱ ሁለት ጊዜ እጦማለሁ፥ ከማገኘውም ሁሉ አሥራት አወጣለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, YAHUAH be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.am: ቀራጩ ግን በሩቅ ቆሞ ዓይኖቹን ወደ ሰማይ ሊያነሣ እንኳ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኔን ኃጢአተኛውን ማረኝ እያለ ደረቱን ይደቃ ነበር።

verses.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ከዚያ ይልቅ ይህ ጻድቅ ሆኖ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፤ ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፥ ራሱን ግን የሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.am: እንዲዳስሳቸውም ሕፃናትን ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም አይተው ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.en: But Yahushua called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ። ሕፃናት ወደ እኔ ይመጡ ዘንድ ተዉአቸው አትከልክሉአቸውም፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ እነዚህ ላሉት ናትና።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of YAHUAH as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት እንደ ሕፃን የማይቀበላት ሁሉ ከቶ አይገባባትም አለ።

verses.en: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.am: ከአለቆችም አንዱ። ቸር መምህር፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንድወርስ ምን ላድርግ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ ምን ቸር ትለኛለህ? ከአንዱ ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር ቸር ማንም የለም።

verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
verses.am: ትእዛዛቱን ታውቃለህ፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥ አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር አለው።

verses.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህን ሁሉ ከሕፃንናቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Now when Yahushua heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ሰምቶ። አንዲት ገና ቀርታሃለች፤ ያለህን ሁሉ ሽጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሰምቶ እጅግ ባለ ጠጋ ነበርና ብዙ አዘነ።

verses.en: And when Yahushua saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of YAHUAH!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ እንዳዘነ አይቶ። ገንዘብ ላላቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት መግባት እንዴት ጭንቅ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ባለ ጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ይልቅ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ሊገባ ይቀላል አለ።

verses.en: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
verses.am: የሰሙትም። እንግዲህ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with YAHUAH.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። በሰው ዘንድ የማይቻል በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይቻላል አለ።

verses.en: Then Kepha said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of YAHUAH's sake,
verses.am: እርሱም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ቤትን ወይም ወላጆችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን የተወ፥

verses.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
verses.am: በዚህ ዘመን ብዙ እጥፍ በሚመጣውም ዓለም የዘላለምን ሕይወት የማይቀበል ማንም የለም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Yerushalayim, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱንም ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ እንዲህ አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ ስለ ሰው ልጅም በነቢያት የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸማል።

verses.en: For he shall be delivered unto the nations, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታልና፥ ይዘብቱበትማል ያንገላቱትማል ይተፉበትማል፤

verses.en: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.am: ከገረፉትም በኋላ ይገድሉታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል።

verses.en: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከዚህ ነገር ምንም አላስተዋሉም፥ ይህም ቃል ተሰውሮባቸው ነበር፥ የተናገረውንም አላወቁም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም በቀረበ ጊዜ አንድ ዕውር እየለመነ በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
verses.am: ሕዝብም ሲያልፍ ሰምቶ። ይህ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And they told him, that Yahushua of Nazareth passeth by.
verses.am: እነርሱም። የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ያልፋል ብለው አወሩለት።

verses.en: And he cried, saying, Yahushua, thou Son of Dawid, have mercy on me.
verses.am: እርሱም። የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of Dawid, have mercy on me.
verses.am: በስተ ፊት ይሄዱ የነበሩትም ዝም እንዲል ገሠጹት፤ እርሱ ግን። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረኝ እያለ አብዝቶ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Yahushua stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ወደ እርሱ እንዲያመጡት አዘዘ። በቀረበም ጊዜ። ምን ላደርግልህ ትወዳለህ? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Master, that I may receive my sight.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አይ ዘንድ ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እይ፤ እምነትህ አድኖሃል አለው።

verses.en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying YAHUAH: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም አየ፥ እግዚአብሔንም እያከበረ ተከተለው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.en: And Yahushua entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.am: ወደ ኢያሪኮም ገብቶ ያልፍ ነበር። እነሆም ዘኬዎስ የሚባል ሰው፥

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.am: እርሱም የቀራጮች አለቃ ነበረ፥ ባለ ጠጋም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he sought to see Yahushua who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም የትኛው እንደ ሆነ ሊያይ ይፈልግ ነበር፤ ቁመቱም አጭር ነበረና ስለ ሕዝቡ ብዛት አቃተው።

verses.en: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.am: በዚያችም መንገድ ያልፍ ዘንድ አለውና ያየው ዘንድ ወደ ፊት ሮጦ በአንድ ሾላ ላይ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when Yahushua came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደዚያ ስፍራ በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ አሻቅቦ አየና። ዘኬዎስ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ በቤትህ እውል ዘንድ ይገባኛልና ፈጥነህ ውረድ አለው።

verses.en: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.am: ፈጥኖም ወረደ በደስታም ተቀበለው።

verses.en: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.am: ሁሉም አይተው። ከኃጢአተኛ ሰው ጋር ሊውል ገባ ብለው አንጐራጐሩ።

verses.en: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Master; Behold, Master, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.am: ዘኬዎስ ግን ቆሞ ጌታን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካለኝ ሁሉ እኵሌታውን ለድሆች እሰጣለሁ፤ ማንንም በሐሰት ከስሼ እንደ ሆንሁ አራት እጥፍ እመልሳለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እርሱ ደግሞ የአብርሃም ልጅ ነውና ዛሬ ለዚህ ቤት መዳን ሆኖለታል፤

verses.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ሊፈልግና ሊያድን መጥቶአለና አለው።

verses.en: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Yerushalayim, and because they thought that the kingdom of YAHUAH should immediately appear.
verses.am: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መቅረቡ ስለ ሆነ የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ፈጥኖ ሊገለጥ እንዳለው ስለ መሰላቸው ምሳሌ ጭምር ተናገረ።

verses.en: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እንዲህ አላቸው። አንድ መኰንን ለራሱ መንግሥትን ይዞ ሊመለሰ ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
verses.am: አሥር ባሪያዎችንም ጠርቶ አሥር ምናን ሰጣቸውና። እስክመጣ ድረስ ነግዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.am: የአገሩ ሰዎች ግን ይጠሉት ነበርና። ይህ በላያችን ሊነግሥ አንወድም ብለው በኋላው መልክተኞችን ላኩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.am: መንግሥትንም ይዞ በተመለሰ ጊዜ፥ ገንዘብ የሰጣቸውን እነዚህን ባሪያዎች ነግደው ምን ያህል እንዳተረፉ ያውቅ ዘንድ እንዲጠሩለት አዘዘ።

verses.en: Then came the first, saying, Master, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
verses.am: የፊተኛውም ደርሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አሥር ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
verses.am: እርሱም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ባሪያ፥ በጥቂት የታመንህ ስለ ሆንህ በአሥር ከተማዎች ላይ ሥልጣን ይሁንልህ አለው።

verses.en: And the second came, saying, Master, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምናንህ አምስት ምናን አተረፈ አለው።

verses.en: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
verses.am: ይህንም ደግሞ። አንተም በአምስት ከተማዎች ላይ ሁን አለው።

verses.en: And another came, saying, Master, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
verses.am: ሌላውም መጥቶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በጨርቅ ጠቅልዬ የጠበቅኋት ምናንህ እነሆ፤

verses.en: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
verses.am: ፈርቼሃለሁና፥ ጨካኝ ሰው ስለ ሆንህ፤ ያላኖርኸውን ትወስዳለህ ያልዘራኸውንም ታጭዳለህ አለው።

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
verses.am: እርሱም። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ አፍህ በተናገረው እፈርድብሃለሁ። እኔ ያላኖርሁትን የምወስድና ያልዘራሁትን የማጭድ ጨካኝ ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ አወቅህ፤ ምን ነው ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ያልሰጠኸው?

verses.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
verses.am: እኔም መጥቼ ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
verses.am: በዚያም ቆመው የነበሩትን። ምናኑን ውሰዱበት አሥሩ ምናን ላለውም ስጡት አላቸው።

verses.en: (And they said unto him, Master, he hath ten pounds.)
verses.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አሥር ምናን አለው አሉት።

verses.en: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁ፥ ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋል፥ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው ስንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እነዚያን በላያቸው ልነግሥ ያልወደዱትን ጠላቶቼን ወደዚህ አምጡአቸው በፊቴም እረዱአቸው።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ይህንም ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጣ ይቀድማቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.am: ደብረ ዘይትም በሚባል ተራራ አጠገብ ወዳሉት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌና ወደ ቢታንያ በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለቱን ላከና።

verses.en: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
verses.am: በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ ወደ እርስዋም ገብታችሁ ከሰው ማንም ገና ያልተቀመጠበት ውርንጫ ታስሮ ታገኛላችሁ፥ ፈትታችሁም አምጡት።

verses.en: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Master hath need of him.
verses.am: ማንም። ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? ብሎ ቢጠይቃችሁ፥ እንዲሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል በሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
verses.am: የተላኩትም ሄደው እንዳላቸው አገኙ።

verses.en: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
verses.am: እነርሱም ውርንጫውን ሲፈቱ ጌቶቹ። ውርንጫውን ስለ ምን ትፈቱታላችሁ? አሉአቸውም

verses.en: And they said, The Master hath need of him.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለጌታ ያስፈልገዋል አሉ።

verses.en: And they brought him to Yahushua: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Yahushua thereon.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጡት፥ በውርንጫውም ላይ ልብሳቸውን ጭነው ኢየሱስን አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
verses.am: ሲሄድም ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise YAHUAH with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
verses.am: ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ቍልቍለትም አሁን በቀረበ ጊዜ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁላቸው ደስ እያላቸው ተአምራትን ሁሉ ስላዩ በታላቅ ድምፅ እግዚአብሔርን ሊያመሰግኑ ጀምረው።

verses.en: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Master: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
verses.am: በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ ንጉሥ የተባረከ ነው፤ በሰማይ ሰላም በአርያምም ክብር አሉ።

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
verses.am: ከሕዝብም መካከል ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህን ገሥጻቸው አሉት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
verses.am: መልሶም። እላችኋለሁ፥ እነዚህ ዝም ቢሉ ድንጋዮች ይጮኻሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
verses.am: ሲቀርብም ከተማይቱን አይቶ አለቀሰላት፥

verses.en: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
verses.am: እንዲህ እያለ። ለሰላምሽ የሚሆነውን በዚህ ቀን አንቺስ ስንኳ ብታውቂ፤ አሁን ግን ከዓይንሽ ተሰውሮአል።

verses.en: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
verses.am: ወራት ይመጣብሻልና፥ ጠላቶችሽም ቅጥር ይቀጥሩብሻል ይከቡሻልም በየበኵሉም ያስጨንቁሻል፤

verses.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
verses.am: አንቺንም በአንቺም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ልጆችሽን ወደ ታች ይጥላሉ፥ በአንቺ ውስጥም ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ አይተዉም፥ የመጐብኘትሽን ዘመን አላወቅሽምና።

verses.en: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ በእርሱ የሚሸጡትን የሚገዙትንም ያወጣ ጀመር፤

verses.en: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.am: እርሱም። ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ እናንተ ግን የወንበዴዎች ዋሻ አደረጋችሁት አላቸው።

verses.en: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች የሕዝቡ ታላላቆችም ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፥

verses.en: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
verses.am: የሚያደርጉበትንም አጡ፤ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሲሰሙት ተንጠልጥለውበት ነበርና።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
verses.am: አንድ ቀንም ሕዝቡን በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር ወንጌልንም ሲሰብክላቸው፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ከሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና።

verses.en: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
verses.am: እስኪ ንገረን፤ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን ታደርጋለህ ወይስ ይህን ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
verses.am: መልሶም። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም ንገሩኝ፤

verses.en: The immersion of Yohanan, was it from heaven, or of men?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከሰማይ ነበረችን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.en: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that Yohanan was a prophet.
verses.am: ከሰው ብንል ግን ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይወግሩናል፤ ዮሐንስ ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ ሁሉ ያምኑ ነበርና አሉ።

verses.en: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አናውቅም አሉት።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.am: ይህንም ምሳሌ ለሕዝቡ ይላቸው ጀመር። አንድ ሰው የወይን አትክልት ተከለ ለገበሬዎችም አከራይቶ ለብዙ ዘመን ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.am: በጊዜውም ከወይኑ አትክልት ፍሬ እንዲሰጡት አንድ ባሪያ ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ፤ ገበሬዎቹ ግን ደበደቡት ባዶውንም ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.am: ጨምሮም ሌላውን ባሪያ ላከ፤ እነርሱም ያን ደግሞ ደበደቡት አዋርደውም ባዶውን ሰደዱት።

verses.en: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
verses.am: ጨምሮም ሦስተኛውን ላከ፤ እነርሱም ይህን ደግሞ አቍሰለው አወጡት።

verses.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
verses.am: የወይኑም አትክልት ጌታ። ምን ላድርግ? የምወደውን ልጄን እልካለሁ፤ ምናልባት እርሱን አይተው ያፍሩታል አለ።

verses.en: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
verses.am: ገበሬዎቹ ግን አይተውት እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ርስቱ ለእኛ እንዲሆን ኑ እንግደለው አሉ።

verses.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
verses.am: ከወይኑም አትክልት ወደ ውጭ አውጥተው ገደሉት። እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ ምን ያደርጋቸዋል?

verses.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, YAHUAH forbid.
verses.am: ይመጣል እነዚህንም ገበሬዎች ያጠፋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ለሌሎች ይሰጣል። ይህንም በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህስ አይሁን አሉ።

verses.en: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ወደ እነርሱ ተመልክቶ። እንግዲህ። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ይህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.am: በዚያም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ሁሉ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ግን ይፈጨዋል አለ።

verses.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም ይህን ምሳሌ በእነርሱ ላይ እንደ ተናገረ አውቀው በዚያች ሰዓት እጃቸውን ሊጭኑበት ፈለጉ ነገር ግን ሕዝቡን ፈሩ።

verses.en: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
verses.am: ሲጠባበቁም ወደ ገዢ ግዛትና ሥልጣን አሳልፈው እንዲሰጡት ጻድቃን መስለው በቃሉ የሚያጠምዱትን ሸማቂዎች ሰደዱበት።

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of YAHUAH truly:
verses.am: ጠይቀውም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነትን እንድትናገርና እንድታስተምር ለሰው ፊትም እንዳታደላ እናውቃለን፥ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ታስተምራለህ እንጂ፤

verses.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
verses.am: ለቄሣር ግብር ልንሰጥ ተፈቅዶአልን? ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።

verses.en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ተንኰላቸውንም ተመልክቶ። ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ? አንድ ዲናር አሳዩኝ፤

verses.en: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
verses.am: መልኩ ጽሕፈቱስ የማን ነው? አላቸው። መልሰውም። የቄሣር ነው አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto YAHUAH the things which be YAHUAH's.
verses.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ፊት በቃሉ ሊያጠምዱት አልቻሉም በመልሱም እየተደነቁ ዝም አሉ።

verses.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
verses.am: ትንሣኤ ሙታንንም የሚክዱ ከሰዱቃውያን አንዳንዶቹ ቀርበው ጠየቁት፥

verses.en: Saying, Master, Mosheh wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.am: እንዲህ ሲሉ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ። ሚስት ያለችው የአንድ ሰው ወንድም ልጅ ሳይወልድ ቢሞት፥ ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ ብሎ ጻፈልን።

verses.en: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ ሰባት ወንድማማች ነበሩ፤ የፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሞተ፤

verses.en: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.en: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ደግሞ ሞተች።

verses.en: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰባቱ አግብተዋታልና ሴቲቱ በትንሣኤ ከእነርሱ ለማንኛቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የዚህ ዓለም ልጆች ያገባሉ ይጋባሉም፥

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.am: ያን ዓለምና ከሙታን ትንሣኤ ሊያገኙ የሚገባቸው እነዚያ ግን አያገቡም አይጋቡምም፥ እንደ መላእክት ናቸውና፥

verses.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.am: ሊሞቱም ወደ ፊት አይቻላቸውም፥ የትንሣኤም ልጆች ስለ ሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of YAHUAH, being the children of the resurrection.
verses.am: ሙታን እንዲነሡ ግን ሙሴ ደግሞ በቍጥቋጦው ዘንድ ጌታን የአብርሃም አምላክ የይስሐቅም አምላክ የያዕቆብም አምላክ በማለቱ አስታወቀ፤

verses.en: Now that the dead are raised, even Mosheh shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Master YAHUAH of Abraham, and YAHUAH of Yitschaq, and YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ሁሉ ለእርሱ ሕያዋን ስለ ሆኑ፥ የሕያዋን አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሙታን አይደለም።

verses.en: For he is not a YAHUAH of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
verses.am: ከጻፎችም አንዳንዶቹ መልሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ መልካም ተናገርህ አሉት።

verses.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
verses.am: ወደ ፊትም አንድ ነገር ስንኳ ሊጠይቁት አልደፈሩም።

verses.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ የዳዊት ልጅ ነው እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.en: And he said unto them, How say they that Messiah is Dawid's son?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?

verses.en: And Dawid himself saith in the book of Psalms, YAHUAH said unto my Master, Sit thou on my right hand,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዳዊት። ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል፥ እንዴትስ ልጁ ይሆናል?

verses.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሲሰሙ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን።

verses.en: Dawid therefore calleth him Master, how is he then his son?
verses.am: ረጃጅም ልብስ ለብሰው መዞር ከሚፈልጉ፥ በገበያም ሰላምታ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥ በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ ከሚወዱ ከጻፎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
verses.am: የመበለቶችን ቤት የሚበሉ ጸሎታቸውንም በማስረዘም የሚያመካኙ፥ እነዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ይቀበላሉ አለ።

verses.en: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.am: ዓይኑንም አንሥቶ መባቸውን በመዝገብ የሚጥሉ ባለ ጠጎችን አየ።

verses.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.am: አንዲትም ድሀ መበለት ሁለት ሳንቲም በዚያ ስትጥል አየና።

verses.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህች ድሀ መበለት ከሁሉ ይልቅ አብልጣ ጣለች፤

verses.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of YAHUAH: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከትርፋቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር መዝገብ ጥለዋልና፤ ይህች ግን ከጕድለትዋ የነበራትን ትዳርዋን ሁሉ ጣለች አለ።

verses.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.am: አንዳንዶቹም ስለ መቅደስ በመልካም ድንጋይና በተሰጠው ሽልማት እንዳጌጠ ሲነጋገሩ። ይህማ የምታዩት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.am: ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ የማይቀርበት ዘመን ይመጣል አለ።

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.am: እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? ይህስ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዳለው ምልክቱ ምንድር ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እንዳትስቱ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ብዙዎች። እኔ ነኝ፥ ዘመኑም ቀርቦአል እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ እነርሱን ተከትላችሁ አትሂዱ።

verses.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.am: ጦርንና ሁከትንም በሰማችሁ ጊዜ አትደንግጡ፤ ይህ አስቀድሞ ይሆን ዘንድ ግድ ነውና፥ ነገር ግን መጨረሻው ወዲያው አይሆንም።

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ፥ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣል፤

verses.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.am: ታላቅም የምድር መናወጥና በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ቸነፈር ራብም ይሆናል፤ የሚያስፈራም ነገር ከሰማይም ታላቅ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በፊት እጃቸውን በላያችሁ ይጭናሉ ያሳድዱአችሁማል፤ ስለ ስሜም ወደ ምኵራብና ወደ ወኅኒ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ወደ ነገሥታትና ወደ ገዥዎችም ይወስዱአችኋል፤

verses.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.am: ይህም ለምስክርነት ይሆንላችኋል።

verses.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.am: ሰለዚህ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ አስቀድማችሁ እንዳታስቡ በልባችሁ አኑሩት፤

verses.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.am: ወደረኞቻችሁ ሁሉ ሊቃወሙና ሊከራከሩ የማይችሉትን አፍና ጥበብ እሰጣችኋለሁና።

verses.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.am: ወላጆችም ስንኳ ወንድሞችም ዘመዶችም ወዳጆችም አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ ከእናንተም አንዳንዱን ይገድላሉ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.am: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.am: ከራሳችሁም አንዲት ጠጉር ስንኳ አትጠፋም፤

verses.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.am: በመታገሣችሁም ነፍሳችሁን ታገኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And when ye shall see Yerushalayim compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ግን በጭፍራ ተከባ ስታዩ በዚያን ጊዜ ጥፋትዋ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።

verses.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉ ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥ በመካከልዋም ያሉ ከእርስዋ ፈቀቅ ይበሉ፥ በገጠር ያሉም ወደ እርስዋ አይግቡ፤

verses.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.am: የተጻፈው ሁሉ እንዲፈጸም ይህ የበቀል ጊዜ ነውና።

verses.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.am: በዚያን ወራት ለእርጕዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው፤ ታላቅ ችግር በምድር ላይ፥ በዚህም ሕዝብ ላይ ቍጣ ይሆናልና፤

verses.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Yerushalayim shall be trodden down of the nations, until the times of the nations be fulfilled.
verses.am: በሰይፍ ስለትም ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አሕዛብ ሁሉም ይማረካሉ፤ የአሕዛብም ዘመን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ኢየሩሳሌም በአሕዛብ የተረገጠች ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.am: በፀሐይና በጨረቃም በከዋክብትም ምልክት ይሆናል፤ በምድር ላይም አሕዛብ ከባሕሩና ከሞገዱም ድምፅ የተነሣ እያመነቱ ይጨነቃሉ፤

verses.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.am: ሰዎችም ከፍርሃትና በዓለም የሚመጣበትን ከመጠበቅ የተነሣ ይደክማሉ፤ የሰማያት ኃይላት ይናወጣሉና።

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል።

verses.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.am: ይህም ሊሆን ሲጀምር ቤዛችሁ ቀርቦአልና አሻቅባችሁ ራሳችሁን አንሡ።

verses.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.am: ምሳሌንም ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል። በለስንና ዛፎችን ሁሉ እዩ፤

verses.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.am: ሲያቈጠቍጡ ተመልክታችሁ በጋ አሁን እንደ ቀረበ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of YAHUAH is nigh at hand.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ ይህ ሁሉ መሆኑን ስታዩ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እንደ ቀረበች እወቁ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልባችሁ በመጠጥ ብዛትና በስካር ስለ ትዳርም በማሰብ እንዳይከብድ፥ ያ ቀንም በድንገት እንዳይመጣባችሁ ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.am: በምድር ሁሉ ላይ በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ እንደ ወጥመድ ይደርስባቸዋልና።

verses.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሊመጣ ካለው ከዚህ ሁሉ ለማምለጥ፥ በሰው ልጅም ፊት ለመቆም እንድትችሉ ስትጸልዩ ሁል ጊዜ ትጉ።

verses.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.am: ዕለት ዕለትም በመቅደስ ያስተምር ነበር፥ ሌሊት ግን ደብረ ዘይት ወደምትባል ተራራ ወጥቶ ያድር ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ይሰሙት ዘንድ ማልደው በመቅደስ ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.am: ፋሲካም የሚባለው የቂጣ በዓል ቀረበ።

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም እንዴት እንዲያጠፉት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበርና።

verses.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ቍጥር አንዱ በነበረው የአስቆሮቱ በሚባለው በይሁዳ ገባ፤

verses.en: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.am: ሄዶም እንዴት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከመቅደስ አዛዦች ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.am: እነርሱም ደስ አላቸው፥ ገንዘብም ሊሰጡት ተዋዋሉ።

verses.en: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.am: እሺም አለ፥ ሕዝብም በሌለበት አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ምቹ ጊዜ ይፈልግ ነበር።

verses.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.am: ፋሲካንም ሊያርዱበት የሚገባው የቂጣ በዓል ደረሰ፤

verses.en: And he sent Kepha and Yohanan, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስንም። ፋሲካን እንድንበላ ሄዳችሁ አዘጋጁልን ብሎ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.am: እነርሱም። ወዴት እናዘጋጅ ዘንድ ትወዳለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.am: እርሱም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ወደ ከተማ ስትገቡ ማድጋ ውኃ የተሸከመ ሰው ይገናኛችኋል፤ ወደ ሚገባበት ቤት ተከተሉት፤

verses.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.am: ለባለቤቱም። መምህሩ። ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ፋሲካን የምበላበት የእንግዳ ቤት ክፍል ወዴት ነው? ይልሃል በሉት፤

verses.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.am: ያም በደርብ ላይ ያለውን የተነጠፈ ታላቅ አዳራሽ ያሳያችኋል፤ በዚያም አሰናዱልን።

verses.en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.am: ሄደውም እንዳላቸው አገኙና ፋሲካን አሰናዱ።

verses.en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.am: ሰዓቱም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.am: እርሱም። ከመከራዬ በፊት ከእናንተ ጋር ይህን ፋሲካ ልበላ እጅግ እመኝ ነበር፤

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ወደ ፊት ከዚህ አልበላም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
verses.am: ጽዋንም ተቀበለ አመስግኖም። ይህን እንካችሁ በመካከላችሁም ተካፈሉት፤

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of YAHUAH shall come.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እስክትመጣ ድረስ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ከወይኑ ፍሬ አልጠጣም አለ።

verses.en: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.am: እንጀራንም አንሥቶ አመሰገነ ቆርሶም ሰጣቸውና። ስለ እናንተ የሚሰጠው ሥጋዬ ይህ ነው፤ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።

verses.en: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ከእራት በኋላ ጽዋውን አንሥቶ እንዲህ አለ። ይህ ጽዋ ስለ እናንተ በሚፈሰው በደሜ የሚሆን አዲስ ኪዳን ነው።

verses.en: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ እጅ እነሆ በማዕድ ከእኔ ጋር ናት።

verses.en: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅስ እንደ ተወሰነው ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።

verses.en: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ይህን ሊያደርግ ያለው ማን እንደ ሆነ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠያየቁ ጀመር።

verses.en: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.am: ደግሞም ማናቸውም ታላቅ ሆኖ እንዲቈጠር በመካከላቸው ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the nations exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። የአሕዛብ ነገሥታት ይገዙአቸዋል፥ በላያቸውም የሚሠለጥኑት ቸርነት አድራጊዎች ይባላሉ።

verses.en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ አትሁኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ታላቅ የሆነ በመካከላችሁ እንደ ታናሽ፥ የሚገዛም እንደሚያገለግል ይሁን።

verses.en: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.am: በማዕድ የተቀመጠ ወይስ የሚያገለግል ማናቸው ታላቅ ነው? የተቀመጠው አይደለምን? እኔ ግን በመካከላችሁ እንደሚያገለግል ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ በፈተናዎቼ ከእኔ ጋር ጸንታችሁ የኖራችሁ ናችሁ፤

verses.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.am: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤

verses.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ጌታም። ስምዖን ስምዖን ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰይጣን እንደ ስንዴ ሊያበጥራችሁ ለመነ፤

verses.en: And the Master said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
verses.am: እኔ ግን እምነትህ እንዳይጠፋ ስለ አንተ አማለድሁ፤ አንተም በተመለስህ ጊዜ ወንድሞችህን አጽና አለ።

verses.en: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ወኅኒም ወደ ሞትም ከአንተ ጋር ለመሄድ የተዘጋጀሁ ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Master, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ጴጥሮስ ሆይ፥ እልሃለሁ፥ እንዳታውቀኝ ሦስት ጊዜ እስክትክደኝ ድረስ ዛሬ ዶሮ አይጮኽም አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I tell thee, Kepha, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ያለ ኮረጆና ያለ ከረጢት ያለ ጫማም በላክኋችሁ ጊዜ፥ አንዳች ጐደለባችሁን? አላቸው። እነርሱም። አንዳች እንኳ አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.am: እርሱም። አሁን ግን ኮረጆ ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ይውሰድ፥ ከረጢትም ያለው እንዲሁ፤ የሌለውም ልብሱን ሽጦ ሰይፍ ይግዛ።

verses.en: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ ይህ። ከዓመፀኞች ጋር ተቈጠረ ተብሎ የተጻፈው በእኔ ሊፈጸም ግድ ነው፤ አዎን፥ ስለ እኔ የሚሆነው አሁን ይፈጸማልና አላቸው።

verses.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሁለት ሰይፎች አሉ አሉት። እርሱም። ይበቃል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they said, Master, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.am: ወጥቶም እንደ ልማዱ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ደግሞ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.am: ወደ ስፍራውም ደርሶ። ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የድንጋይ ውርወራ የሚያህል ራቀ፥ ተንበርክኮም። አባት ሆይ፥

verses.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.am: ብትፈቅድ ይህችን ጽዋ ከእኔ ውሰድ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔ ፈቃድ አይሁን የአንተ እንጂ እያለ ይጸልይ ነበር።

verses.en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.am: ከሰማይም መጥቶ የሚያበረታ መልአክ ታየው።

verses.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.am: በፍርሃትም ሲጣጣር አጽንቶ ይጸልይ ነበር፤ ወዙም በምድር ላይ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ደም ነጠብጣብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.am: ከጸሎትም ተነሥቶ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጣና ከኀዘን የተነሣ ተኝተው ሲያገኛቸው።

verses.en: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.am: ስለ ምን ትተኛላችሁ? ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ተነሥታችሁ ጸልዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.am: ገናም ሲናገር እነሆ፥ ሰዎች መጡ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱም ይሁዳ የሚባለው ይቀድማቸው ነበር፥ ሊስመውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበ።

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Yahushua to kiss him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ በመሳም የሰውን ልጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጣለህን? አለው።

verses.en: But Yahushua said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.am: በዙሪያውም የነበሩት የሚሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በሰይፍ እንምታቸውን? አሉት።

verses.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Master, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዱ የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ቀኝ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።

verses.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። ይህንስ ፍቀዱ አለ፤ ጆሮውንም ዳስሶ ፈወሰው።

verses.en: And Yahushua answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ እርሱ ለመጡበት ለካህናት አለቆችና ለመቅደስ አዛዦች ለሽማግሌዎችም። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ወጣችሁን?

verses.en: Then Yahushua said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.am: በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት ከእናንተ ጋር ስሆን እጆቻችሁን አልዘረጋችሁብኝም፤ ይህ ግን ጊዜያችሁና የጨለማው ሥልጣን ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.am: ይዘውም ወሰዱት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናት ቤትም አገቡት፤ ጴጥሮስም ርቆ ይከተለው ነበር።

verses.en: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Kepha followed afar off.
verses.am: በግቢ መካከልም እሳት አንድደው በአንድነት ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ጴጥሮስ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Kepha sat down among them.
verses.am: በብርሃኑም በኩል ተቀምጦ ሳለ አንዲት ገረድ አየችውና ትኵር ብላ። ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለች።

verses.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። አንቺ ሴት፥ አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ጊዜም በኋላ ሌላው አይቶት። አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አለው። ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ እኔ አይደለሁም አለ።

verses.en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Kepha said, Man, I am not.
verses.am: አንድ ሰዓትም የሚያህል ቆይቶ ሌላው አስረግጦ። እርሱ የገሊላ ሰው ነውና በእውነት ይህ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ አለ።

verses.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን። አንተ ሰው፥ የምትለውን አላውቅም አለ። ያን ጊዜም ገና ሲናገር ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Kepha said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.am: ጌታም ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን ተመለከተው፤ ጴጥሮስም። ዛሬ ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ እንዳለው የጌታ ቃል ትዝ አለው።

verses.en: And the Master turned, and looked upon Kepha. And Kepha remembered the word of the Master, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ ምርር ብሎ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: And Kepha went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም የያዙት ሰዎች ይዘብቱበትና ይደበድቡት ነበር፤

verses.en: And the men that held Yahushua mocked him, and smote him.
verses.am: ሸፍነውም ፊቱን ይመቱት ነበርና። በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው? ትንቢት ተናገር እያሉ ይጠይቁት ነበር።

verses.en: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.am: ሌላም ብዙ ነገር እየተሳደቡ በእርሱ ላይ ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.am: በነጋም ጊዜ የሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችና የካህናት አለቆች ጻፎችም ተሰብስበው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ወሰዱትና

verses.en: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.am: ክርስቶስ አንተ ነህን? ንገረን አሉት። እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ብነግራችሁ አታምኑም፤

verses.en: Art thou the Messiah? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.am: ብጠይቅም አትመልሱልኝም አትፈቱኝምም።

verses.en: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከአሁን ጀምሮ የሰው ልጅ በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ቀኝ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሁላቸውም። እንግዲያስ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህን? አሉት። እርሱም። እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ እናንተ ትላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of YAHUAH? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ራሳችን ከአፉ ሰምተናልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ምን ምስክር ያስፈልገናል? አሉ።

verses.en: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.am: ሁሉም በሞላው ተነሥተው ወደ ጲላጦስ ወሰዱትና።

verses.en: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Messiah a King.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝባችንን ሲያጣምም ለቄሣርም ግብር እንዳይሰጥ ሲከለክል ደግሞም። እኔ ክርስቶስ ንጉሥ ነኝ ሲል አገኘነው ብለው ይከሱት ጀመር።

verses.en: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Yehudim? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። አንተ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው። እርሱም መልሶ። አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሕዝቡ። በዚህ ሰው አንድ በደል ስንኳ አላገኘሁበትም አለ።

verses.en: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን አጽንተው። ከገሊላ ጀምሮ እስከዚህ ድረስ በይሁዳ ሁሉ እያስተማረ ሕዝቡን ያውካል አሉ።

verses.en: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.am: ጲላጦስ ግን። ገሊላ ሲሉ በሰማ ጊዜ። የገሊላ ሰው ነውን? ብሎ ጠየቀ፤

verses.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Yerushalayim at that time.
verses.am: ከሄሮድስም ግዛት እንደ ሆነ ባወቀ ጊዜ ወደ ሄሮድስ ሰደደው፤ እርሱ ደግሞ በዚያ ጊዜ በኢየሩሳሌም ነበረና።

verses.en: And when Herod saw Yahushua, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ኢየሱስን ባየው ጊዜ እጅግ ደስ አለው፤ ስለ እርሱ ስለ ሰማ ከብዙ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሊያየው ይመኝ ነበርና፥ ምልክትም ሲያደርግ ሊያይ ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር።

verses.en: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.am: በብዙ ቃልም ጠየቀው፤ እርሱ ግን አንድ ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎችም አጽንተው ሲከሱት ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሠራዊቱ ጋር ናቀው ዘበተበትም፥ የጌጥ ልብስም አልብሶ ወደ ጲላጦስ መልሶ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.am: ሄሮድስና ጲላጦስም በዚያን ቀን እርስ በርሳቸው ወዳጆች ሆኑ፥ ቀድሞ በመካከላቸው ጥል ነበረና።

verses.en: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.am: ጲላጦስም፥ የካህናትን አለቆችና መኳንንትን ሕዝቡንም በአንድነት ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው።

verses.en: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ያጣምማል ብላችሁ ይህን ሰው ወደ እኔ አመጣችሁት፤ እነሆም፥ በፊታችሁ መርምሬ ከምትከሱበት ነገር አንድ በደል ስንኳ በዚህ ሰው አላገኘሁበትም።

verses.en: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ደግሞ ምንም አላገኘም፤ ወደ እኛ መልሶታልና፤ እነሆም፥ ለሞት የሚያደርሰው ምንም አላደረገም፤

verses.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.am: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤

verses.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.am: ሁላቸውም በአንድነት። ይህን አስወግድ፥ በርባንንም ፍታልን እያሉ ጮኹ፤

verses.en: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.am: እርሱም ሁከትን በከተማ አንሥቶ ሰውን ስለ ገደለ በወኅኒ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ኢየሱስን ሊፈታ ወድዶ ዳግመኛ ተናገራቸው፤

verses.en: Pilate therefore, willing to release Yahushua, spake again to them.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እነርሱ። ስቀለው ስቀለው እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.en: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.am: ሦስተኛም። ምን ነው? ያደረገውስ ክፋት ምንድር ነው? ለሞት የሚያደርሰው በደል አላገኘሁበትም፤ ስለዚህ ቀጥቼ እፈታዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንዲሰቀል በታላቅ ድምፅ አጽንተው ለመኑት። የእነርሱ ጩኸትና የካህናት አለቆችም ቃል በረታ።

verses.en: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ልመናቸው እንዲሆንላቸው ፈረደበት።

verses.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.am: ያንን የለመኑትንም፥ ስለ ሁከት ሰውንም ስለ መግደል በወኅኒ ታስሮ የነበረውን አስፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ለፈቃዳቸው አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Yahushua to their will.
verses.am: በወሰዱትም ጊዜ ስምዖን የተባለ የቀሬናን ሰው ከገጠር ሲመጣ ይዘው ከኢየሱስ በኋላ መስቀሉን እንዲሸከም ጫኑበት።

verses.en: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Yahushua.
verses.am: ዋይ ዋይ ከሚሉና ሙሾ ከሚያወጡ ሴቶችና ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ብዙዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤

verses.en: But Yahushua turning unto them said, Daughters of Yerushalayim, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተራራዎችን። በላያችን ውደቁ፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ሰውሩን ይሉ ዘንድ ይጀምራሉ፤

verses.en: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.am: በእርጥብ እንጨት እንዲህ የሚያደርጉ ከሆኑ፥ በደረቀውስ እንዴት ይሆን?

verses.en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.am: ሌሎችንም ሁለት ክፉ አድራጊዎች ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ይገድሉ ዘንድ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.am: ቀራንዮም ወደሚባል ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ እርሱን ክፉ አድራጊዎቹንም አንዱን በቀኝ ሁለተኛውንም በግራ ሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አባት ሆይ፥ የሚያደርጉትን አያውቁምና ይቅር በላቸው አለ። ልብሱንም ተካፍለው ዕጣ ተጣጣሉበት።

verses.en: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ቆመው ይመለከቱ ነበር። መኳንንቱም ደግሞ። ሌሎችን አዳነ፤ እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር የተመረጠው ክርስቶስ ከሆነ፥ ራሱን ያድን እያሉ ያፌዙበት ነበር።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.am: ጭፍሮችም ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው ሆምጣጤም አምጥተው።

verses.en: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Messiah, the chosen of YAHUAH.
verses.am: አንተስ የአሁድ ንጉሥ ከሆንህ፥ ራስህን አድን እያሉ ይዘብቱበት ነበር።

verses.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.am: ይህ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው ተብሎ በግሪክና በሮማይስጥ በዕብራይስጥም ፊደል የተጻፈ ጽሕፈት ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And saying, If thou be the king of the Yehudim, save thyself.
verses.am: ከተሰቀሉት ከክፉ አድራጊዎቹም አንዱ። አንተስ ክርስቶስ አይደለህምን? ራስህንም እኛንም አድን ብሎ ሰደበው።

verses.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Ibri, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.am: ሁለተኛው ግን መልሶ። አንተ እንደዚህ ባለ ፍርድ ሳለህ እግዚአብሔርን ከቶ አትፈራውምን?

verses.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Messiah, save thyself and us.
verses.am: ስለ አደረግነውም የሚገባንን እንቀበላለንና በእኛስ እውነተኛ ፍርድ ነው፤ ይህ ግን ምንም ክፋት አላደረገም ብሎ ገሠጸው።

verses.en: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear YAHUAH, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በመንግሥትህ በመጣህ ጊዜ አስበኝ አለው።

verses.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ዛሬ ከእኔ ጋር በገነት ትሆናለህ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto Yahushua, Master, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.am: ስድስት ሰዓትም ያህል ነበረ፥ ጨለማም እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ሆነ፥ ፀሐይም ጨለመ፥

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.am: የቤተ መቅደስም መጋረጃ ከመካከሉ ተቀደደ።

verses.en: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ። አባት ሆይ፥ ነፍሴን በእጅህ አደራ እሰጣለሁ አለ። ይህንም ብሎ ነፍሱን ሰጠ።

verses.en: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም የሆነውን ነገር ባየ ጊዜ። ይህ ሰው በእውነት ጻድቅ ነበረ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አከበረ።

verses.en: And when Yahushua had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.am: ይህንም ለማየት ተከማችተው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ደረታቸውን እየደቁ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified YAHUAH, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.am: የሚያውቁቱ ግን ሁሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ሴቶችም ይህን እያዩ በሩቅ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በጎና ጻድቅ ሰው የሸንጎ አማካሪም የሆነ ዮሴፍ የሚባል ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.am: ይህም በምክራቸውና በሥራቸው አልተባበረም ነበር፤ አርማትያስም ከምትባል ከአይሁድ ከተማ ሆኖ እርሱ ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይጠባበቅ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man named Yoseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.am: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው፤

verses.en: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Yehudim: who also himself waited for the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: አውርዶም በተልባ እግር ልብስ ከፈነው፥ ማንም ገና ባልተቀበረበት ከዓለትም በተወቀረ መቃብር አኖረው።

verses.en: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Yahushua.
verses.am: የመዘጋጀት ቀንም ነበረ፤ ሰንበትም ሊጀምር ነበረ።

verses.en: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.am: ከገሊላም ከእርሱ ጋር የመጡት ሴቶች ተከትለው መቃብሩን ሥጋውንም እንዴት እንዳኖሩት አዩ።

verses.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.am: ተመልሰውም ሽቱና ቅባት አዘጋጁ። በሰንበትም እንደ ትእዛዙ ዐረፉ።

verses.en: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሳምንቱ በመጀመሪያው ቀን ያዘጋጁትን ሽቱ ይዘው ከእነርሱም ጋር አንዳንዶቹ ወደ መቃብሩ እጅግ ማልደው መጡ።

verses.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.am: ድንጋዩንም ከመቃብሩ ተንከባሎ አገኙት፥

verses.en: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Master Yahushua.
verses.am: ገብተውም የጌታን የኢየሱስን ሥጋ አላገኙም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.am: እነርሱም በዚህ ሲያመነቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁለት ሰዎች የሚያንጸባርቅ ልብስ ለብሰው ወደ እነርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
verses.am: ፈርተውም ፊታቸውን ወደ ምድር አቀርቅረው ሳሉ፥ እንዲህ አሉአቸው። ሕያውን ከሙታን መካከል ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ተነሥቶአል እንጂ በዚህ የለም።

verses.en: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ሊሰጥና ሊሰቀል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ሊነሣ ግድ ነው እያለ ገና በገሊላ ሳለ ለእናንተ እንደ ተናገረ አስቡ።

verses.en: And they remembered his words,
And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.am: ቃሎቹንም አሰቡ፥ ከመቃብሩም ተመልሰው ይህን ሁሉ ለአሥራ አንዱና ለሌሎች ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው።

verses.en: It was Miryam Magdalene, and Joanna, and Miryam the mother of Ya'aqob, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.am: ይህንም ለሐዋርያት የነገሩአቸው መግደላዊት ማርያምና ዮሐና የያዕቆብም እናት ማርያም ከእነርሱም ጋር የነበሩት ሌሎች ሴቶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.am: ይህም ቃል ቅዠት መስሎ ታያቸውና አላመኑአቸውም።

verses.en: Then arose Kepha, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን ተነሥቶ ወደ መቃብር ሮጠ፤ በዚያም ዝቅ ብሎ ሲመለከት የተልባ እግር ልብስን ብቻ አየ፤ በሆነውም ነገር እየተደነቀ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Yerushalayim about threescore furlongs.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከእነርሱ ሁለቱ በዚያ ቀን ከኢየሩሳሌም ስድሳ ምዕራፍ ያህል ወደሚርቅ ኤማሁስ ወደሚባል መንደር ይሄዱ ነበር፤

verses.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ስለ ሆነው ነገር ሁሉ እርስ በርሳቸው ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Yahushua himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.am: ሲነጋገሩና ሲመራመሩም፥ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ቀርቦ ከእነርሱ ጋር ይሄድ ነበር፤

verses.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዳያውቁት ዓይናቸው ተይዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.am: እርሱም። እየጠወለጋችሁ ስትሄዱ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁ የምትነጋገሩአቸው እነዚህ ነገሮች ምንድር ናቸው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Yerushalayim, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.am: ቀለዮጳ የሚባልም አንዱ መልሶ። አንተ በኢየሩሳሌም እንግዳ ሆነህ ለብቻህ ትኖራለህን? በእነዚህ ቀኖች በዚያ የሆነውን ነገር አታውቅምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Yahushua of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before YAHUAH and all the people:
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እንዲህ አሉት። በእግዚአብሔርና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት በሥራና በቃል ብርቱ ነቢይ ስለ ነበረው ስለ ናዝሬቱ ስለ ኢየሱስ፤

verses.en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.am: እርሱንም የካህናት አለቆችና መኳንንቶቻችን ለሞት ፍርድ እንዴት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡትና እንደ ሰቀሉት ነው።

verses.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Yisra'el: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.am: እኛ ግን እስራኤልን እንዲቤዥ ያለው እርሱ እንደ ሆነ ተስፋ አድርገን ነበር፤ ደግሞም ከዚህ ሁሉ ጋር ይህ ከሆነ ዛሬ ሦስተኛው ቀን ነው።

verses.en: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.am: ደግሞም ከእኛ ውስጥ ማልደው ከመቃብሩ ዘንድ የነበሩት አንዳንድ ሴቶች አስገረሙን፤

verses.en: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.am: ሥጋውንም ባጡ ጊዜ። ሕያው ነው የሚሉ የመላእክትን ራእይ ደግሞ አየን ሲሉ መጥተው ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.am: ከእኛም ጋር ከነበሩት ወደ መቃብር ሄደው ሴቶች እንደ ተናገሩት ሆኖ አገኙት፥ እርሱን ግን አላዩትም።

verses.en: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተ የማታስተውሉ፥ ነቢያትም የተናገሩትን ሁሉ ልባችሁ ከማመን የዘገየ፤

verses.en: Ought not Messiah to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ይህን መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድና ወደ ክብሩ ይገባ ዘንድ ይገባው የለምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And beginning at Mosheh and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.am: ከሙሴና ከነቢያት ሁሉ ጀምሮ ስለ እርሱ በመጻሕፍት ሁሉ የተጻፈውን ተረጐመላቸው።

verses.en: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.am: ወደሚሄዱበትም መንደር ቀረቡ፥ እርሱም ሩቅ የሚሄድ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.am: እነርሱ። ከእኛ ጋር እደር፥ ማታ ቀርቦአልና ቀኑም ሊመሽ ጀምሮአል ብለው ግድ አሉት፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሊያድር ገባ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ እንጀራውን አንሥቶ ባረከው፥ ቈርሶም ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.am: ዓይናቸውም ተከፈተ፥ አወቁትም፤ እርሱም ከእነርሱ ተሰወረ።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። በመንገድ ሲናገረን መጻሕፍትንም ሲከፍትልን ልባችን ይቃጠልብን አልነበረምን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Yerushalayim, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.am: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።

verses.en: Saying, The Master is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.am: እነርሱም በመንገድ የሆነውን እንጀራውንም በቈረሰ ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።

verses.en: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.am: ይህንም ሲነጋገሩ ኢየሱስ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ። ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው።

verses.en: And as they thus spake, Yahushua himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ደነገጡና ፈሩ መንፈስም ያዩ መሰላቸው።

verses.en: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለ ምን ትደነግጣላችሁ? ስለ ምንስ አሳብ በልባችሁ ይነሣል?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.am: እኔ ራሴ እንደ ሆንሁ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን እዩ፤ በእኔ እንደምታዩት፥ መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውምና እኔን ዳስሳችሁ እዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.am: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከደስታ የተነሣ ገና ስላላመኑ ሲደነቁ ሳሉ። በዚህ አንዳች የሚበላ አላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.am: እነርሱም ከተጠበሰ ዓሣ አንድ ቁራጭ፥ ከማር ወለላም ሰጡት፤

verses.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.am: ተቀብሎም በፊታቸው በላ።

verses.en: And he took it, and did eat before them.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ በሙሴ ሕግና በነቢያት በመዝሙራትም ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይገባል ብዬ የነገርኋችሁ ቃሌ ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Mosheh, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም መጻሕፍትን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው፤

verses.en: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። ክርስቶስ መከራ ይቀበላል በሦስተኛውም ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል፥

verses.en: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Messiah to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.am: በስሙም ንስሐና የኃጢአት ስርየት ከኢየሩሳሌም ጀምሮ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበካል ተብሎ እንዲሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: እናንተም ለዚህ ምስክሮች ናችሁ።

verses.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አባቴ የሰጠውን ተስፋ እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ከላይ ኃይል እስክትለብሱ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከተማ ቆዩ።

verses.en: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Yerushalayim, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.am: እስከ ቢታንያም አወጣቸው እጆቹንም አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።

verses.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.am: ሲባርካቸውም ከእነርሱ ተለየ ወደ ሰማይም ዐረገ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.am: እነርሱም፤ ሰገዱለትና በብዙ ደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥

verses.en: And they worshipped him, and returned to Yerushalayim with great joy:
verses.am: ዘወትርም እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እየባረኩ በመቅደስ ኖሩ።

verses.en: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing YAHUAH. Amen.
